articles.title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
articles.abstract: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc}: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.
articles.titleCn: ArchSpace：记录、审查和参考LLM架构研究
articles.abstractCn: 模型架构决定了大语言模型的扩展行为、训练效率和推理成本，因此成为产业界和学术界共同关注的焦点。在产业界，DeepSeek、Qwen和Kimi等团队常规性地引入架构创新，但公开报告很少记录哪些想法成功、哪些被放弃以及原因。在学术界，计算资源有限和基线不一致常常将评估限制在小规模、单点比较，难以确定改进是否在大规模上有效或转化为更广泛的影响。ArchSpace作为一个公开平台，通过记录、评审和引用架构研究来弥补这两个空白：每个提案都记录其实验和推理过程，由社区评审，并为后续工作提供引用。为了在昂贵的大规模训练前评估想法，ArchSpace利用规模定律从小规模实验预测模型在大规模上的损失，这一做法在产业界被广泛采用。我们提供初始引用使平台可用：Qwen3.5和OLMo3基线、拟合的规模定律以及可复用的训练配方。通过评审验证的想法可以反过来成为新的基线，ArchSpace旨在拓宽塑造下一代模型的思路范围。

articles.title: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
articles.abstract: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
articles.titleCn: 学习扩散语言模型何时应该再生
articles.abstractCn: 重新掩码允许扩散语言模型回顾生成的文本，但有效的修正需要知道何时以及如何进行修订。我们对数独问题的诊断揭示了两个缺陷。隐藏状态包含错误信息，而这些信息并不能通过标记置信度可靠地暴露，并且当周围上下文保持固定时，重新掩码一个孤立错误通常会再次产生该错误。这些发现促使我们提出了DiVR，一个验证器，它可以预测部分生成的序列是否能够达到正确答案。DiVR在模型自身轨迹的最终正确性上进行训练，决定何时重新生成一个块以及保留哪个替代方案，而生成器本身保持不变。在五个推理基准测试中，使用LLaDA-8B-Base，DiVR将微调生成器的平均准确率从35.3%提高到43.4%，其成本是贪婪解码的1.9-3.5倍，高于使用3.8-7.4倍成本的搜索基线。它还可以补充训练后的微调，如监督微调和强化学习，并推广到其他生成器，包括Dream。

articles.title: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
articles.abstract: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting on available memory saves effort as the task unfolds. We introduce Coding-Repository Memory (CoReMem), a cost-internalizing framework that guides memory design and actor adaptation through measured memory value on the next task. Prospective segment valuation compares runs of the next task with and without individual trajectory segments from the same inherited repository state, guiding a compact memory built around anchors: repository locations and executable checks. Actor adaptation estimates on-policy memory value within rollout groups with and without memory, using a reward that prioritizes resolution and penalizes step count in successful runs. Provenance-gated value credit assigns the additional value term to steps identified as using memory-supplied anchors, while every step retains outcome credit. On ChainSWE, CoReMem raises the 27B actor's resolve rate from 21.0% to 25.7%, with 17% fewer steps and 11% fewer total cache-aware tokens, including memory-module calls, relative to the untrained actor model without memory.
articles.titleCn: CoReMem：面向连续编码任务的具有前瞻性评估的成本内化记忆
articles.abstractCn: 编码代理在不断发展中的知识库上处理连续任务，在下一个任务未知前完成编辑并写入记忆。选择记忆以应对未知任务需要权衡未来效用与写入和读取的成本。代理还需决定何时利用可用记忆以节省任务展开过程中的精力。我们引入了编码-知识库记忆（CoReMem）框架，该框架通过衡量下一任务中的记忆价值来指导记忆设计和代理适应。前瞻性片段评估通过比较下一任务包含和不包含来自相同继承知识库状态的个别轨迹片段的运行，指导围绕锚点构建紧凑记忆：知识库位置和可执行检查。代理适应通过在包含和不包含记忆的展开组中估计在策线上记忆价值，使用优先考虑解决并惩罚成功运行步数的奖励。来源门控价值信用将额外价值项分配给被识别为使用记忆提供的锚点的步骤，同时每一步都保留结果信用。在ChainSWE上，CoReMem将27B代理的解决率从21.0%提高到25.7%，相比无记忆且未经训练的代理模型，步骤减少了17%，总缓存感知令牌（包括记忆模块调用）减少了11%。

articles.title: Linking Rapid Learning to Compositional Structure in Neural Networks: Evidence from Additive Analogies in Meta-Learned Parameter Spaces
articles.abstract: Humans can learn rapidly from limited experience, while neural networks typically require extensive training. In this work, we investigate what properties of a neural network can enable it to learn rapidly. We study neural networks that have been optimized via meta-learning, a technique that exposes a network to many related functions to facilitate its subsequent learning of similar functions. Prior work has shown that these meta-learned networks can learn new functions rapidly, but how they do so remains unclear. To investigate their internal structure, we take inspiration from classic work demonstrating additive relationships among the learned vectors that neural networks use to represent words (e.g., "king" minus "man" plus "woman" approximates "queen"). Analogously, we look for additive relationships among a meta-learned network's "representations" of different functions; when a meta-learned network rapidly learns to implement a specific function, all of its adapted parameter values can be concatenated into a single vector that we treat as representing the function. We find that such parameter vectors can be added and subtracted according to symbolic relationships among the functions they represent, yielding new parameter vectors that successfully represent the functions predicted by the corresponding symbolic manipulations: the networks specified by these artificially recombined vectors actually implement the intended functions without any direct training on them. Our results suggest that meta-learning can tune a network's starting point to organize subsequent learning along systematic, functionally meaningful trajectories through the space of possible parameter vectors, providing a geometric basis for realizing inductive biases in neural networks.
articles.titleCn: 将快速学习与神经网络中的组合结构联系起来：来自元学习参数空间中加性类比的证据
articles.abstractCn: 人类可以从有限的经历中快速学习，而神经网络通常需要大量的训练。在这项工作中，我们研究了神经网络的哪些特性可以使其快速学习。我们研究的是通过元学习优化后的神经网络，这是一种技术，它将网络暴露于许多相关函数中，以促进其后续学习相似函数。已有研究表明，这些元学习优化的网络可以快速学习新函数，但它们是如何做到的仍然不清楚。为了研究它们的内部结构，我们从经典工作中获得灵感，这些经典工作展示了神经网络用来表示单词的学习向量之间的加性关系（例如，“king”减去“man”加上“woman”近似等于“queen”）。类似地，我们寻找元学习优化网络对不同函数的“表示”之间的加性关系；当一个元学习优化网络快速学习实现特定函数时，它所有的调整后的参数值可以被连接成一个向量，我们将其视为代表该函数。我们发现，这些参数向量可以根据它们所代表的函数之间的符号关系进行加法和减法运算，从而产生新的参数向量，这些新参数向量成功地代表了相应符号运算预测的函数：由这些人工重组的向量指定的网络实际上在不进行任何直接训练的情况下实现了预期函数。我们的结果表明，元学习可以调整网络的起点，以沿着可能的参数向量空间中系统化、功能上有意义的轨迹组织后续学习，为在神经网络中实现归纳偏差提供了几何基础。

articles.title: Goal Encoding in LLMs
articles.abstract: We investigate whether and how LLMs encode goals: internal neural representations that precede and guide action, and that are flexible enough to be realized through many different execution paths. We construct a coding setting with multiple sub-tasks that allows us to evaluate goal-seeking behavior and the selection of sub-goals. In this setting, we localize an encoding of the next sub-goal in the outputs of a sparse set of attention heads. The same heads can be used to decode the LM's future actions in natural language (e.g., "I'm checking if a word is a palindrome"). We verify that this encoding is causal for next action and is plastic: transplanting it into a different environment, e.g., another programming language, triggers the same operation realized with a different sequence of tokens. The LM also sustains the encoding throughout the action's execution, which is puzzling because a transformer LM without recurrence cannot carry a state forward for more tokens than it has layers left. We propose that it does not need to. Under a non-recurrent goal-seeking (NRGS) account, the LM frequently re-reads the goal from the task specification, compares it with the progress visible in the growing context, and pursues what remains. We test the predictions of this account with targeted causal interventions.

articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中的目标编码
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）如何编码目标：这些目标作为先于并指导行动的内部神经表征，具有足够的灵活性，可以通过多种不同的执行路径来实现。我们构建了一个包含多个子任务的环境，使我们能够评估目标寻求行为和子目标的选择。在这个环境中，我们将下一个子目标的编码定位在稀疏注意力头的一组输出中。相同的注意力头可用于解码LLM的自然语言未来行动（例如，“我在检查一个词是否是回文”）。我们验证了这种编码对下一个行动具有因果性，并且具有可塑性：将其移植到不同的环境中（例如，另一种编程语言），会触发使用不同token序列实现的相同操作。LLM还能够在行动执行过程中保持这种编码，这令人费解，因为无递归的Transformer模型无法在剩余层数少于token数量的情况下保持状态。我们提出它不需要这样做。在非递归目标寻求（NRGS）解释下，LLM频繁地从任务规范中重新读取目标，将其与在增长上下文中可见的进展进行比较，并追求剩余部分。我们通过有针对性的因果干预来检验这一解释的预测。

articles.title: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
articles.abstract: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve $1.68\times$--$2.05\times$ gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated $2.14\times$ sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code available at https://github.com/WangHaoZhe/metal-sandbox and https://github.com/WangHaoZhe/harbor
articles.titleCn: 金属沙盒：用于苹果硅基芯片上GPU编程代理的隔离执行和命令调度
articles.abstractCn: 设备端推理需要能够有效利用本地加速器的内核。生成Apple Metal内核的模型的训练和评估效率，受益于原生的macOS工具和并发代理会话。这些会话在模型请求、开发命令和GPU执行之间交替，导致在部署过程中GPU容量大部分闲置。我们提出了Metal Sandbox，这是一项结合了实例级文件访问限制、原生命令执行和跨互联Mac的命令级调度的基础设施。每个代理保留其工作空间和私有开发环境。并行命令可以同时运行，而串行命令每个节点共享一个执行槽；符合条件的等待命令可以迁移到可用的Mac上，并将结果返回给原始代理。与Harbor的集成支持通过通用工作流执行任务、自动验证和部署收集。在四台Mac mini M4节点上的受控实验表明，在集中需求下，命令吞吐量提升了1.68倍至2.05倍。十六个静态代理跟踪数据显示，每个节点四个会话相比于一个会话，在会话持续补充且平均持续时间不变的情况下，可持续吞吐量提升了2.14倍。在动态调度下重放这些测量跟踪，假设阶段持续时间不变，平均工具等待时间减少了18.8%，批量耗时减少了22.3%。Metal Sandbox及其Harbor集成已在GitHub上开源。

articles.title: Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically relies on a verifier that can reliably judge whether sampled solutions are correct. However, in many realistic settings, complete verification is generally unavailable, while cheap checks can only falsify failures. We formalize this regime as one-sided verifiability (OSV): verified negatives are reliable counterexamples, but verified positives are merely non-falsified candidates and may contain many false positives. This asymmetry makes standard RLVR unreliable, because reinforcing verified positives can directly reward shortcuts that pass partial checks. To address this issue, we propose Negative-Only Policy Optimization (NOPO), which treats verified positives as unlabeled and updates the policy only by suppressing trusted verified negatives. Specifically, NOPO combines a reference-relative negative suppression loss with a group-level adapter that scales each update by the proportion of non-falsified responses. Across unit-test, constraint-check, and LLM self-verifiers, NOPO improves pass@k over baselines on code, logic, and math benchmarks when oracle rewards are unavailable. These gains persist under inference-time scaling and cross-benchmark transfer.
articles.titleCn: 负值仅政策优化用于单边可验证奖励
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）通常依赖于能够可靠判断采样解是否正确的验证器。然而，在许多现实场景中，完整验证往往不可用，而廉价的检查只能识别错误。我们将这种机制形式化为单向可验证性（OSV）：验证的负例是可靠的反例，但验证的正例仅仅是未被证伪的候选，可能包含大量误报。这种不对称性使得标准RLVR不可靠，因为强化验证的正例会直接奖励通过部分检查的捷径。为解决此问题，我们提出了仅负例策略优化（NOPO），将验证的正例视为未标记，并通过抑制可信的验证负例来更新策略。具体而言，NOPO结合了参考相对负例抑制损失和一个组级适配器，该适配器按未被证伪响应的比例缩放每次更新。在单元测试、约束检查和LLM自验证器中，当无法获得神谕奖励时，NOPO在代码、逻辑和数学基准测试上提升了pass@k指标，这些优势在推理时间扩展和跨基准迁移中依然存在。

articles.title: Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs
articles.abstract: We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content. The user may then unknowingly transmit that information by sharing the generated artifact, say as an email, social-media post, or message, through ordinary communication channels. An adversary monitoring these channels can discover this information. We demonstrate this threat by training two open-weight models to infer gender and age-group labels from conversational cues and encode their predictions using invisible characters or word choices. These results show that user-shared model outputs can become a covert channel for personal inferences, even when the model itself has no direct means of contacting an adversary.
articles.titleCn: 合成走私：恶意隐藏在大型语言模型输出中的推演个人属性
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了“合成走私”（Synthesis Smuggling）这一新型威胁模型，其中对抗性大型语言模型（LLM）通过日常寻求帮助的交互推断用户的敏感信息，并将其隐写编码到看似无害的模型生成内容中。用户随后可能在不知情的情况下通过分享生成的工件（例如电子邮件、社交媒体帖子或消息）等常规通信渠道传输这些信息。监控这些渠道的对手可以发现这些信息。我们通过训练两个开源权重模型来演示这一威胁，这些模型能够从对话线索中推断性别和年龄组标签，并使用不可见字符或词语选择来编码它们的预测。这些结果表明，用户共享的模型输出可能成为个人推断的隐蔽通道，即使模型本身没有直接联系对手的手段。

articles.title: Maximizing Capacity Utilization of LoRA Adapters for Mitigating the Learning-Forgetting Trade-off
articles.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning, especially in heterogeneous and continual-learning settings in which substantial forgetting occurs. In general, it suffers from an undesirable learning-forgetting trade-off across diverse fine-tuning settings. We identify a potential contributor: LoRA adapters, especially high-rank ones, frequently fail to realize the available capacity afforded by the configured rank. Specifically, we find that standard LoRA updates have effective rank far below their configured rank, limiting how broadly the update energy is distributed. Therefore, we propose training mechanisms that optimize the original objective while maximizing adapter effective rank. Our main method adds a simple, stable, differentiable, and SVD-free Rényi-2 effective-rank regularizer to the language-modeling loss. We also connect capacity maximization to norm-bounded updates. In mixed-domain rank sweeps on three models evaluated with multiple random seeds, a penalty weight of $λ=0.01$ lowers mean Wiki perplexity at every tested rank of at least $16$ relative to unpenalized LoRA. Mean training perplexity improves or increases by at most $0.02$ in all but one model-rank comparison. Single-task and scheduling experiments further show that the balance between learning and retention depends on the configuration. We also observe that several LoRA variants in the literature also suffer from the identified capacity issue, and our approach provides a complementary axis of improvement to LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning. These results suggest that effective rank is not only a post-hoc diagnostic of adapter quality, but a trainable objective for improving the learning-forgetting frontier. Our code is available at https://github.com/tomohiro-sawada/lora-capacity-utilization
articles.titleCn: 最大化LoRA适配器的容量利用率以缓解学习-遗忘权衡
articles.abstractCn: 低秩适配（LoRA）通常表现不如全量微调，尤其是在异构和持续学习环境中，这些环境会出现显著的遗忘现象。通常情况下，它在不同的微调设置中存在一个不理想的学-忘权衡问题。我们识别出一个潜在原因：LoRA适配器，尤其是高秩适配器，经常无法充分利用配置的秩所提供的可用容量。具体来说，我们发现标准的LoRA更新其有效秩远低于配置的秩，这限制了更新能量分布的广泛性。因此，我们提出了优化原始目标并最大化适配器有效秩的训练机制。我们的主要方法是在语言模型损失中添加一个简单、稳定、可微且无需SVD的Rényi-2有效秩正则化项。我们还把容量最大化与范数约束更新联系起来。在三个模型上进行的混合域秩扫描实验中，使用多个随机种子评估，惩罚权重λ=0.01在所有测试秩（至少为16）上，相对于未加惩罚的LoRA，降低了平均维基百科困惑度。在除一个模型秩比较外，所有模型秩比较中，平均训练困惑度改善或最多增加0.02。单任务和调度实验进一步表明，学习和保留之间的平衡取决于配置。我们还观察到文献中的一些LoRA变体也存在已识别的容量问题，我们的方法为基于LoRA的参数高效微调提供了补充改进维度。这些结果表明，有效秩不仅是适配器质量的后期诊断指标，也是一个可训练的目标，用于改进学-忘前沿。我们的代码可在https://github.com/tomohiro-sawada/lora-capacity-utilization获取。

articles.title: Parsed, Plausible, Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing
articles.abstract: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens. On the PIZZA ordering benchmark we fine-tune two sub-billion models (Qwen3.5-0.8B and LFM2.5-350M) with LoRA on six lossless encodings of the same target tree, from 44.3 down to 10.9 tokens per order, including two matched-length pairs that vary surface form at fixed length. Across 300 runs (5 training pool sizes, 5 seeds) with a hierarchical bootstrap and Holm correction fixed before the results were read, shortening alone never helps, but writing the target in ordinary words does. The word encoding is the most accurate format on both models (87.5% vs. 85.8% exact match for the native s-expression on Qwen) while emitting 4.1x fewer tokens, and it cuts the silent error rate by 2.3x on Qwen and 1.8x on LFM2, separating at every pool size. Error analysis locates much of the gain in negation. All runs also learn to refuse off-menu input (held out: 95.9-99.0% handled) and to apply in-utterance self-corrections. Strict refusal has a measured price: 2.1-10.1% of real, mostly polite, orders are refused.

articles.titleCn: 解析、合理、错误：输出格式控制在小模型语义解析中的静默错误
articles.abstractCn: 一个微调的解析器，虽然能生成结构正确但错误的树，却会静默失败：下游没有任何东西能察觉。我们探究输出格式——一个自由的设计选择——是否控制了这种情况的发生频率。在PIZZA排序基准测试中，我们使用LoRA对两个十亿以下模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B和LFM2.5-350M）进行微调，针对同一目标树的六种无损编码，从每个订单44.3个token减少到10.9个token，其中包括两个长度匹配但表面形式不同的对。在300次运行中（5种训练池大小，5个种子），采用分层引导和Holm校正，在结果读取前固定，单独缩短长度并无帮助，但将目标用普通文字书写则有效。词编码在两个模型上都是最准确的格式（Qwen的原生s表达式精确匹配率为87.5% vs 85.8%），同时token数量减少4.1倍，并将Qwen的静默错误率降低2.3倍，LFM降低1.8倍，在所有池大小下均有效。错误分析表明大部分收益来自否定词。所有运行还学会了拒绝菜单外输入（保留数据：处理率为95.9%-99.0%）和应用语句内自我纠正。严格的拒绝措施有代价：2.1%-10.1%的真实订单（大多礼貌）被拒绝。

articles.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
articles.abstract: Decision models answer a question with a typed output, such as a choice among options with a probability for each, so one model can choose an agent's actions, evaluate actions already taken, or score every action to teach a policy with reinforcement learning. Prior work has studied them mainly as actors, judging their usefulness by how well they act. We ask whether a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well. We compare three decision models and three general LLMs as actors and judges on ALFWorld, and use JEV as a teacher on ALFWorld and WebShop. As actors, all six models are pulled away from a subgoal that must come first by an easier one. As judges that see the whole trajectory, the same models credit the steps toward that subgoal, and asking whether each action helped, rather than whether the task will succeed, separates useful from useless actions. As a teacher, JEV raises a Qwen2.5-1.5B policy over GRPO from 72.8% to 82.9% success on ALFWorld and from 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop. These results suggest that a poor actor can still teach well, because judging an action after the episode ends reveals the consequences that acting must anticipate. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/decision-agents.
articles.titleCn: 演员、法官还是教师？理解长时程智能体中的决策模型
articles.abstractCn: 决策模型通过类型化的输出回答问题，例如在选项中选择并给出每种选项的概率，因此一个模型可以选择代理的行动、评估已采取的行动或对每个行动打分以通过强化学习教授策略。先前的研究主要将它们作为行动者来研究，通过它们行动的好坏来判断其效用。我们探究一个行动表现不佳的决策模型是否仍然能够很好地教授策略。我们在ALFWorld上比较了三个决策模型和三个通用LLM作为行动者和评判者，并使用JEV在ALFWorld和WebShop上作为教师。作为行动者，所有六个模型都被一个更容易的子目标带离了必须首先完成的子目标。作为能够看到整个轨迹的评判者，相同的模型认可了朝向该子目标的步骤，并且询问每个行动是否有助于完成任务，而不是询问任务是否会成功，从而区分了有用和无用的行动。作为教师，JEV将GRPO上的Qwen2.5-1.5B策略的成功率从72.8%提升到82.9%在ALFWorld上，从56.8%提升到71.4%在WebShop上。这些结果表明，一个行动表现不佳的模型仍然可以很好地教授策略，因为在事件结束后评判一个行动揭示了行动必须预见的后果。代码可在https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/decision-agents获取。

articles.title: Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation: Differentiable Length Control for Concise Clinical Reasoning in Smaller Language Models
articles.abstract: Smaller language models (SLMs) make it feasible to deploy clinical natural language processing where large proprietary models are too costly, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning allows them to be specialised on commodity hardware. One obstacle persists after training: on medical tasks these models answer at far greater length than the clinical question requires. In clinical decision support and point-of-care use, where time is short, such verbosity is hard to act on even when the underlying reasoning is sound. Existing length-control methods depend on preference optimisation, reward models, or proprietary teachers that undercut the accessibility making SLMs attractive. We introduce Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation (PECA), which adds a single differentiable conciseness term to the QLoRA supervised fine-tuning objective. Because the token count is discrete and non-differentiable, PECA instead raises the end-of-sequence probability once generation exceeds a token budget, a smooth signal optimised during ordinary training, with no preference data, no auxiliary model, and a single commodity GPU. On a 1.7-billion-parameter model fine-tuned on the medical-o1-reasoning-SFT corpus, PECA reduces mean response length by 72.8% while improving multiple-choice diagnostic accuracy from 40.8% to 44.0%. A sweep over the conciseness strength traces an interpretable accuracy-to-length frontier for balancing brevity and diagnostic completeness.
articles.titleCn: 参数高效简洁适应：小语言模型中简洁临床推理的可微分长度控制
articles.abstractCn: 小型语言模型（SLMs）使得在大型专有模型成本过高的情况下部署临床自然语言处理成为可能，参数高效的微调则允许它们在通用硬件上进行专业化。训练后仍存在一个障碍：在这些模型回答医学任务时，其长度远超临床问题的要求。在临床决策支持和即时护理应用中，由于时间紧迫，即使底层推理合理，这种冗长也难以应对。现有的长度控制方法依赖于偏好优化、奖励模型或专有教师，这些方法降低了SLMs的可访问性。我们引入了参数高效简洁适应（PECA），它向QLoRA监督微调目标中添加了一个单一的微分简洁性项。由于令牌计数是离散且不可微分的，PECA在生成超过令牌预算时，通过提高序列结束概率来增强简洁性，这是一个在常规训练期间优化的平滑信号，无需偏好数据、无需辅助模型，也只需一个通用GPU。在一个在医学-o1推理-SFT语料库上微调的1.7亿参数模型上，PECA将平均响应长度减少了72.8%，同时将多项选择题诊断准确率从40.8%提高到44.0%。对简洁性强度的扫描描绘了一条可解释的准确率-长度边界，用于平衡简洁性和诊断完整性。

articles.title: CapLite: Prompt-Injection Defense for Small Language Model Agents without Model-Written Security Artifacts
articles.abstract: Enforcement defenses against prompt injection, such as CaMeL, Progent, IPIGuard and DRIFT, ask the agent's own model to write a security artifact (a program, a privilege policy, a dependency graph or a constraint list) that code then enforces. We ask whether small language model (SLM) agents can be trusted to write these artifacts. Across 15 open-weight models, 13 of them between 1.7B and 12B parameters, they cannot: the policies, graphs and constraints that the agent's model writes admit attacks on 14 (Progent), 13 (IPIGuard) and 11 (DRIFT) of the models, and CaMeL's programs fail to run in up to 68% of episodes. We present CapLite, which derives its policy from the tool schemas, commits the write calls before any tool result is read, and admits a write only if every argument that decides whom or what it affects is stated in the user's request. This guarantees write integrity: injected text cannot add a write, and no write reaches a recipient, amount, object or destination that the user did not state. No attack succeeds in 13,935 attacked AgentDojo episodes. CapLite reaches utility under attack comparable to CaMeL's (29.0% vs. 27.2%) with fewer tokens than every other enforcement defense and than the undefended agent: 17.1k per episode, 18% of CaMeL's, and the highest utility per token of all enforcement defenses.
articles.titleCn: CapLite：为小型语言模型代理提供提示注入防御，无需模型编写的安全组件
articles.abstractCn: 针对提示注入的执行防御措施，如CaMeL、Progent、IPIGuard和DRIFT，要求代理自身的模型编写安全工件（如程序、权限策略、依赖图或约束列表），然后代码执行这些工件。我们探究小型语言模型（SLM）代理是否能够被信任来编写这些工件。在15个开放权重模型中，13个模型参数在1.7B到12B之间，它们都不能：代理模型编写的策略、图和约束对14个模型（Progent）、13个模型（IPIGuard）和11个模型（DRIFT）存在攻击漏洞，而CaMeL的程序在高达68%的交互中无法运行。我们提出了CapLite，它从工具模式中提取策略，在读取任何工具结果之前提交写操作调用，并且只有在用户请求中明确声明了影响对象或内容的每个参数时才允许写操作。这保证了写操作的完整性：注入的文本无法添加写操作，且没有写操作会到达用户未声明的接收者、数量、对象或目的地。在13,935个受攻击的AgentDojo交互中，没有攻击成功。CapLite在受攻击情况下的效用与CaMeL相当（29.0% vs. 27.2%），但使用的token数量少于其他所有执行防御措施和未防御的代理：每交互17.1k个token，相当于CaMeL的18%，并且是所有执行防御措施中每token效用最高的。

articles.title: LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs
articles.abstract: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, $\texttt{llama.cpp}$'s K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At $1\%$ and $3.5\%$ perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are $5.7-31.4\%$ smaller than the best $\texttt{llama.cpp}$ format. A bit-exact $0.21$ mm$^2$ ASIC decoder unit ($1$ GHz, $7$ nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to $36\%$ and $38\%$ ($54\%$ and $44\%$ with prompt-lookup speculation). On the Nano, $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ needs $58-64\%$ less time and $53-57\%$ less energy per token than CPU $\texttt{llama.cpp}$, and runs a streamed Mistral-7B 6.6$\times$ faster at $3.89$ bits per weight. A Huffman decoder beats an rANS decoder in rate and area at equal throughput; the ASIC decoder unit runs bit-exact on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA (AMD ZCU102).
articles.titleCn: 懒惰权重：按需解码边缘大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 内存决定边缘设备运行哪些大型语言模型（LLM）以及运行速度：在4 GB Jetson Nano上的容量，在8 GB Jetson Orin Nano Super上的带宽。部署格式（GPTQ、AWQ、$\texttt{llama.cpp}$的K-和I量化）对矩阵的每个整数代码分配相等的比特数，尽管这些代码远非均匀分布。$\texttt{LazyWeights}$保留这些格式，但调整GPTQ使代码可压缩，以无损耗的霍夫曼编码方式在交错通道中编码它们，并在DRAM和L2之间的小单元中按需解码，因此GPU内核无需更改，DRAM仅传输编码后的字节。在1%和3.5%的困惑度预算下，编码的Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B和SmolLM-1.7B比最佳$\texttt{llama.cpp}$格式小5.7-31.4%。一个比特精确的0.21 mm$^2$ ASIC解码单元（1 GHz，7 nm）将Orin的每token延迟和能耗降低高达36%和38%（若使用提示查找推测，则分别为54%和44%）。在Nano上，$\texttt{LazyWeights}$比CPU $\texttt{llama.cpp}$每token节省58-64%的时间和53-57%的能耗，并以每权重3.89比特的速度将流式Mistral-7B速度提升6.6倍。一个霍夫曼解码器在同等吞吐量下比rANS解码器在速率和面积上更优；ASIC解码单元可在Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA（AMD ZCU102）上精确运行比特。

articles.title: Disentangling Spurious Correlations: How IRM Handles Diverse Shortcuts in Text Classification
articles.abstract: In NLP, models trained via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often exploit spurious correlations, such as dialectal markers, at the expense of robust linguistic features, thereby degrading their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. Invariant Risk Minimization (IRM) aims to suppress such shortcuts by identifying predictive relationships that remain stable across environments, but its practical utility for NLP remains debated. We use a causality-driven framework to evaluate IRM under three shortcut-generating mechanisms: label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias. Our results show that IRM successfully rejects shortcuts across the evaluated causal and anti-causal structures, including under limited environmental variation and increasing label noise. We then extend our analysis beyond controlled synthetic artifacts to two less constrained settings: gender-profession associations in Bias in Bios and semantically loaded actor-name shortcuts in ActorCorr. These experiments show that invariant learning can mitigate more realistic textual shortcuts, while semantically meaningful features require careful calibration of the invariance penalty.
articles.titleCn: 解开虚假关联：IRM如何处理文本分类中的各种捷径
articles.abstractCn: 在自然语言处理（NLP）中，通过经验风险最小化（ERM）训练的模型常常利用虚假关联（如方言标记），而牺牲了鲁棒的语言特征，从而降低了它们在分布外（out-of-distribution）的泛化能力。不变风险最小化（IRM）旨在通过识别在环境中保持稳定的关系来抑制此类捷径，但其对NLP的实际效用仍存在争议。我们使用一个以因果性驱动的框架，在三种捷径生成机制下评估IRM：标签生成的特征、混杂因素和选择偏差。我们的结果表明，IRM成功地拒绝了在评估的因果和反因果结构中的捷径，包括在有限的环境变化和标签噪声增加的情况下。然后，我们将分析扩展到受控的合成人工制品之外的两个较少约束的设置：Bias in Bios中的性别-职业关联和ActorCorr中语义负载的演员姓名捷径。这些实验表明，不变学习可以缓解更现实的文本捷径，而具有语义意义的特征需要对不变性惩罚进行仔细校准。

articles.title: Optimal Single-History Tokenization Disambiguation for Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography
articles.abstract: Provably secure linguistic steganography assumes that the receiver recovers the sender's tokens, but a text channel delivers only text, and ambiguous tokenizations break extraction. Existing fixes change the distribution, synchronize whole pools of tokens at a capacity that collapses with large vocabularies, or track several token histories. We prove that if extraction is exact and error-free across full-support language models, a single-history receiver is confined to a prefix-free candidate set at every step -- even if it reads the entire future text and the sender constrains later steps -- and must therefore give up the stop entropy, the entropy of deciding whether each prefix token ends there. Fixing these stop decisions on the prefix forest with shared randomness yields coin projection: a closed-form scheme that attains the bound, works with any distribution coder in one model call per token, preserves ordinary sampling, and refines SyncPool for every key. Across English, Chinese and Japanese, ambiguous text is rare (at most 11 in 1,000 tokens), yet the stop entropy at word and morpheme prefixes takes 7.2-9.0% of the entropy at every step; SyncPool's further loss comes from space and single-byte UTF-8 hubs that merge subtrees while carrying almost no stop uncertainty. Coin projection keeps 91-93% of the string entropy for the coder at every vocabulary size; with the full vocabulary, it turns 2.16-6.85 times as much entropy into message bits as SyncPool and recovers every completed message.
articles.titleCn: 可证明安全的语言隐写术的最佳单历史分词消歧
articles.abstractCn: 可证明安全的语言隐写术假设接收者能够恢复发送者的标记，但文本信道仅传输文本，且模糊的标记化会破坏提取。现有的修复方法改变分布、在词汇量大的情况下同步整个标记池，或追踪多个标记历史。我们证明，如果提取在全支持语言模型中完全精确且无错误，单历史接收者在每一步都局限于前缀候选集——即使它读取了全部未来文本且发送者限制了后续步骤也是如此——因此必须放弃停止熵，即决定每个前缀标记是否在此结束的熵。通过在前缀森林上使用共享随机性修复这些停止决策，得到币投影：一种闭式方案，达到界限，在任何分布编码器中每标记调用一次模型，保持普通采样，并为每个密钥优化SyncPool。在英语、中文和日语中，模糊文本很少（最多每1000个标记中有11个），但词和词素前缀的停止熵占每步熵的7.2-9.0%；SyncPool的进一步损失来自空间和单字节UTF-8枢纽，这些枢纽合并子树时几乎不携带停止不确定性。币投影在每种词汇量下为编码器保留91-93%的字符串熵；使用完整词汇时，它将2.16-6.85倍的熵转化为消息比特，比SyncPool更高效，并能恢复所有完成的消息。

articles.title: Reasoning Supervision and Capability Retention in LoRA Domain Adaptation
articles.abstract: Fine-tuning foundation models on financial data has a wide range of applications, including identifying event types from news, monitoring risk and compliance language, and answering questions over filings and earnings calls. In this setting, the main challenge is to improve task performance without degrading the generalization capabilities of the model. In this paper, we present an extensive set of ablations for fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We compare three training regimes: (1) response-only LoRA, where the supervised response is the label alone; (2) single-adapter reasoning, where reasoning traces from a teacher model are included alongside the labels in the training loss; and (3) dual-adapter composite training, where separate LoRA adapters are trained on traces and labels. Response-only LoRA improves in-domain performance and leaves general capabilities near those of the frozen model. The in-domain change is largest for calibration and argmax accuracy. Under single-adapter reasoning, the in-domain metrics remain behind those of the response-only regime, while MMLU-Pro can rise slightly and the other retention benchmarks stay within ordinary variation. Dual-adapter composite training remains on the same side of this comparison and yields no further gain. Finally, we compress the teacher traces by summarizing them before training, and show that shorter summaries move calibration toward the response-only regime without reaching it.
articles.titleCn: LoRA领域自适应中的推理监督与能力保持
articles.abstractCn: 在金融数据上微调基础模型具有广泛的应用，包括从新闻中识别事件类型、监控风险与合规语言，以及回答涉及申报文件和盈利电话的问题。在这种设置下，主要挑战在于提升任务性能而不损害模型的泛化能力。在本文中，我们提出了一套关于使用低秩适配（LoRA）微调Qwen3-8B的详细消融实验。我们比较了三种训练机制：（1）仅响应的LoRA，其中监督响应仅是标签；（2）单适配器推理，其中教师模型的推理轨迹与标签一同包含在训练损失中；（3）双适配器复合训练，其中分别对轨迹和标签训练独立的LoRA适配器。仅响应的LoRA提升了领域内性能，并使泛化能力接近冻结模型的水平。领域内的变化在校准和argmax精度上最为显著。在单适配器推理下，领域内指标仍落后于仅响应机制，而MMLU-Pro略有提升，其他保留基准保持在正常波动范围内。双适配器复合训练在这项比较中保持一致，并未带来进一步增益。最后，我们在训练前通过总结教师轨迹来压缩它们，并表明较短的总结使校准趋向于仅响应机制，但并未达到该机制。

articles.title: Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution
articles.abstract: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE.
articles.titleCn: 通过程序进化发现有效的智能体记忆设计
articles.abstractCn: 程序进化为发现智能体记忆设计并研究其有效性的底层选择提供了一种有前景的方法。我们介绍了MAPE框架，该框架通过标准化的生命周期接口和迭代式诊断-提议循环，从最小种子进化整个记忆程序。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验表明，在35%的服务成本下，相较于手动设计的基线，MAPE实现了高达12%的绝对精度提升，进一步评估支持了跨服务骨干和基准的迁移。实证分析和消融实验识别并验证了两种常见的设计模式：保留原始对话作为可检索证据可保留从提取记忆中遗漏的细节，而根据查询意图组合检索证据则有助于回答模型有效利用这些证据。将组合模块移植到五个现有的记忆系统中，所有五个系统的精度均得到提升。除此之外，搜索目标决定了计算的去向：在精度与服务成本之间进行优化，会将计算从基于LLM的记忆构建转移到查询时的选择性处理，同时保持具有竞争力的精度。综合这些发现，为智能体记忆设计提供了实证经验。代码可在https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE获取。

articles.title: Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks
articles.abstract: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event. As a result, relationships between concepts must largely be learned from EHR co-occurrence, without directly exploiting any prior semantic knowledge. We investigate how pretrained causal language models can be adapted for longitudinal EHR prediction by developing tEHR. Here, we represent events with their natural language description and use this text stream to apply EHR-adaptive continued pretraining, followed by task-specific discriminative fine-tuning using LoRA, utilising the LLM as a longitudinal patient-encoder. We evaluate this approach across four prediction tasks on the MIMIC-IV dataset and pancreatic cancer prediction on the CPRD dataset at 1 to 12 month horizons, with tEHR using the Mistral-7B-v0.3 backbone achieving the strongest overall performance. Ablations show that performance declines when clinical descriptions are removed or misaligned, when numerical values are omitted, and when either stage of adaptation is removed, while explicit elapsed-time descriptions provide little additional benefit. Analysis of the learned patient representations further reveals clinically coherent structure associated with distinct patterns of disease risk and clinical history.

articles.titleCn: 评估预训练语言语义在结构化电子健康记录预测任务中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 结构化电子健康记录（EHR）模型通常将每个临床概念视为特定数据集的标记，从而丢弃了与事件相关的自然语言语义。因此，概念之间的关系必须主要从EHR共现性中学习，而没有直接利用任何先验的语义知识。我们研究了预训练的因果语言模型如何通过开发tEHR来适应纵向EHR预测。在此，我们用事件的自然语言描述来表示事件，并使用该文本流来应用EHR自适应的持续预训练，然后使用LoRA进行特定任务的判别微调，利用LLM作为纵向患者编码器。我们在MIMIC-IV数据集上针对四个预测任务以及CPRD数据集上针对胰腺癌在1到12个月的预测范围内评估了这种方法，使用Mistral-7B-v0.3主干网络的tEHR实现了最强的整体性能。消融实验表明，当临床描述被移除或错位、数值被省略以及任何阶段的适应被移除时，性能都会下降，而明确的经过时间描述几乎没有提供额外的益处。对学习到的患者表示的分析进一步揭示了与不同疾病风险和临床病史模式相关的临床一致性结构。

articles.title: Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers
articles.abstract: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited. We introduce a benchmark that injects objective, localisable errors of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at three severity levels into real papers and measures each reviewer's detection rate by error type and severity, together with its false-positive rate on clean copies. We also present Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citation-backed claims by retrieving the cited papers, mathematics with computer algebra, and numerical claims with executed code. We apply the benchmark to two corpora of 15 recent arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in machine learning (ML), injecting a total of 357 errors, and evaluate twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available reviewers, and Skepthical. The choice of model has the largest impact on detection rate: given the same prompt, three frontier LLMs differ by about 50 percentage points in total detection on both corpora. Tools and scaffolding help when they contribute what the model cannot supply on its own. In particular, on astrophysics, Claude Code improves on a single Claude call in mathematics and numerics detection, and enforced citation retrieval gives Skepthical the highest citation error detection rate of all systems by a large margin. This citation lead, however, is not observed on ML, where the models appear to know the literature better and Skepthical's citation detection rate is statistically indistinguishable from that of the best single LLM. False-positive rates are below 10% for most systems, but vary with prompt, model, and scaffolding, with mathematics flags the main source of false positives. The evaluation pipeline, the injected errors, and the adjudication logs are released as a benchmark.
articles.titleCn: 审计AI同行评审：一项基于真实科学论文的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 基于大语言模型的同行评审现已应用于大规模生产，但其评估仍存在局限。我们引入了一个基准，将四种类型（普遍问题、数学、数值、引用）的错误以三种严重程度注入真实论文中，并通过错误类型和严重程度测量每位评审员的检测率，以及在干净副本上的假阳性率。我们还介绍了 Skepthical，一个多智能体评审员，它通过检索引用的论文、使用计算机代数验证数学内容、以及执行代码验证数值声明。我们将基准应用于两个包含15篇近期 arXiv 预印本的语料库，一个涉及天体物理学，另一个涉及机器学习（ML），共注入357个错误，并评估了十二个评审系统：六个单大语言模型评审员、两种 Claude Code 配置、三个公开可用的评审员和 Skepthical。模型的选择对检测率影响最大：在相同的提示下，三个前沿大语言模型在两个语料库上的总检测率差异约50个百分点。工具和框架在提供模型自身无法独立完成的功能时有所帮助。特别是在天体物理学领域，Claude Code 在数学和数值检测方面优于单个 Claude 调用，而强制引用检索使 Skepthical 在所有系统中的引用错误检测率以显著优势位居第一。然而，在机器学习领域，这种引用优势并未出现，因为模型似乎对文献的了解更深入，Skepthical 的引用检测率在统计上与最佳单大语言模型无显著差异。大多数系统的假阳性率低于10%，但会随提示、模型和框架的变化而变化，其中数学标记是假阳性率的主要来源。评估流程、注入的错误以及裁决日志被发布为一个基准。

articles.title: Prevalence Bounds for Edited Watermarked Text: Power Envelopes and Calibration Sensitivity
articles.abstract: Watermark detectors decide whether one document came from a watermarked language model. Auditors often need a different number: the share of a corpus that did. We study this share for Gumbel-max and green-list (KGW) watermarks when every document may have been edited by an unknown amount. Without restrictions on the edits, the upper end of the identified set is 1. Combining a known least-favourable next-token distribution with a sequential coupling, we derive a power envelope indexed by three budgets: a retention floor, an entropy budget, and a budget for in-place substitutions, which for Gumbel-max make edited positions look less watermarked than human text. The envelope gives an identified set that is sharp for the alternatives it dominates, finite-sample bounds on the realized share of a fixed corpus with either the exact null or a null calibrated on an independent human sample, and confidence sequences for streams. In Gumbel-max simulations where the envelope binds, the bounds cover, and the threshold that maximizes the gap between envelope and null is generally as tight as twelve thresholds. On text from OPT-1.3B and Qwen3-1.7B, 12,000 fresh human documents scored under three keys show no robust departure from the exact null, and all bounds covered in resampling trials from finite pools of documents with random edits, substitutions and paraphrases; at a share of 0.2 the exact-null bound is about [0.14,0.38]. These results are fragile in two ways we make precise. LLM-paraphrased KGW pools fall below the envelope, yet at 2000 documents the bounds still covered in these trials. A simulated null error of 0.01, comparable to the largest deviation we observed at our thresholds, is likewise harmless at 2000 documents but breaks exact-null coverage at 100,000; a null calibrated on an independent human sample keeps coverage there, but needs a large reference sample to stay narrow.
articles.comment: 31 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code and results: https://github.com/YYKKCC-kevin/watermark-prevalence
articles.titleCn: 编辑后水印文本的流行度界限：功率包络和校准敏感性
articles.abstractCn: 水印检测器用于判断文档是否来自一个带水印的语言模型。审计人员通常需要一个不同的数字：语料库中有多少比例的文档是带水印的。我们研究了Gumbel-max和绿色清单（KGW）水印在这种情况下，每份文档都可能被未知程度地编辑。在没有编辑限制的情况下，识别集合的上限是1。结合已知的最低劣下一个标记分布与顺序耦合，我们推导出一个由三个预算索引的功率包络：保留底线、熵预算和就地替换预算，对于Gumbel-max，编辑过的位置看起来比人类文本更少水印。该包络提供了一个对它支配的替代方案来说非常精确的识别集合，对固定语料库中实现的带水印比例的精确零或独立人类样本校准的零的有限样本界限，以及用于流的置信序列。在Gumbel-max模拟中，当包络起作用时，界限覆盖，并且最大化包络与零之间差距的阈值通常与十二个阈值一样紧密。在OPT-1.3B和Qwen3-1.7B的文本中，12,000份新鲜人类文档在三个关键字下评分，没有显示出与精确零的显著偏离，并且在有限文档池中随机编辑、替换和释义的重采样试验中，所有界限都得到了覆盖；在0.2的比例下，精确零界限大约是[0.14,0.38]。这些结果在两个方面是脆弱的，我们对此做了精确说明。LLM释义的KGW池低于包络，但在2000份文档的情况下，这些试验中的界限仍然覆盖。一个模拟的零误差0.01，与我们观察到的在阈值处的最大偏差相当，在2000份文档时也是无害的，但在100,000份文档时破坏了精确零的覆盖；一个基于独立人类样本校准的零在那里保持覆盖，但需要一个大参考样本才能保持狭窄。

articles.title: Similar but Not Redundant: Embedding-Gated Refinement for High-Granularity Topic Models
articles.abstract: High-granularity topic modelling extracts hundreds of niche topics from a corpus, yet this regime is rarely studied and is more commonly framed as a failure mode: "over-clustering," in which coherent themes fragment into redundant subtopics. We argue that this framing conflates genuine redundancy with topics that are semantically similar but meaningfully distinct, and that the central challenge in high-granularity modelling is separating the two. Recent post-hoc refinement methods address topic redundancy through either embedding-based similarity thresholding or LLM-guided merging. We show that neither suffices in high-granularity settings and propose embedding-gated iterative merge (EGIM), a hybrid approach that iteratively generates context-rich topic representations, uses embedding similarity to propose candidate merges across the topic space, then applies LLM judgement to accept only genuinely redundant pairs while preserving niche distinctions. Across two patent corpora and one legal corpus, LLM judgement rejects 83% of embedding-identified candidates as non-redundant. EGIM improves discriminability on merged topics by 25-55% over a prior iterative LLM baseline while better preserving the original topic distribution.
articles.titleCn: 相似而非冗余：用于高粒度主题模型的嵌入门控细化
articles.abstractCn: 高粒度主题建模能从语料库中提取数百个利基主题，但这一模式很少被研究，通常被视为一种失败模式：“过度聚类”，其中连贯的主题会分裂成冗余的子主题。我们认为这种框架将真实冗余与语义相似但意义上有区别的主题混淆了，而高粒度建模的核心挑战在于区分两者。近期的后处理优化方法通过基于嵌入的相似度阈值或LLM引导的合并来解决主题冗余问题。我们证明这两种方法在高粒度设置下都不够充分，并提出嵌入门控迭代合并（EGIM）方法，这是一种混合方法，它迭代地生成富含上下文的主题表示，利用嵌入相似度在主题空间中提出候选合并，然后应用LLM判断来接受真正冗余的配对，同时保留利基差异。在两个专利语料库和一个法律语料库中，LLM判断拒绝了83%由嵌入识别的候选配对，因为它们不是冗余的。EGIM方法在合并主题的区分性上比先前的迭代LLM基线提高了25-55%，同时更好地保留了原始主题分布。

articles.title: Morphological Simplification in Alzheimer's Disease: Computational Analysis and Identification From Connected Speech
articles.abstract: Purpose: Morphology is often regarded as relatively spared in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and is rarely modeled in connected speech. This study asked which morphological features distinguish speakers with AD from healthy controls, how well morphology classifies AD compared with other linguistic levels and BERT-based models, and whether the signal exceeds transcript length and vocabulary. Method: Fifty-five automatic measures in eight families, seven of them new and theory-motivated, were computed from participant speech in the ADReSS Cookie Theft descriptions (78 AD, 78 controls) and analyzed with group comparisons, equivalence tests, SHAP, family ablation, likelihood-ratio tests, feature-selection classifiers, and BERT-based models. The automatic measures were validated manually, and models were transferred to two other corpora. Results: Nineteen of 38 measures differed between groups: speakers with AD produced fewer suffixed and inflected words, shorter verbs and nouns, and fewer present-progressive but more past-tense forms (largest effect r = -0.42), whereas errors were rare and statistically equivalent between groups. Eight measures survived adjustment for length and lexical frequency. With test-set feature selection, morphology reached a macro-F1 of 0.85, on par with syntax and above fine-tuned BERT (0.80 over five seeds); fully cross-validated selection gave 0.62. Adding morphology to BERT improved AUC (0.91 vs. 0.89) but not macro-F1. Transfer was limited, although two thirds of the effects kept their direction in mild cognitive impairment. Conclusions: AD connected speech shows morphological simplification and temporal reanchoring rather than breakdown. Morphology is more informative than its reputation suggests. Keywords: Alzheimer's disease; morphology; connected speech; ADReSS; inflection; tense and aspect; SHAP; machine learning; BERT
articles.titleCn: 阿尔茨海默病中的形态简化：计算分析与连接语音中的识别
articles.abstractCn: 目的：形态学通常被认为在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中相对保存较好，且很少在连贯语音中进行建模。本研究旨在探究哪些形态学特征能够区分AD患者与健康对照组，形态学与其他语言层级及基于BERT的模型相比的分类效果如何，以及该信号是否超越了转录长度和词汇范围。方法：从ADReSS Cookie Theft描述的参与者语音中计算了八大家族的55个自动测量指标，其中七项为新的、基于理论的测量指标，并通过组间比较、等价检验、SHAP、家族消融、似然比检验、特征选择分类器和基于BERT的模型进行分析。自动测量指标经过人工验证，模型被迁移到其他两个语料库。结果：38项测量指标中有19项存在组间差异：AD患者产生的后缀和屈折词较少，动词和名词较短，现在进行时形式减少但过去时形式增多（最大效应r = -0.42），而错误罕见且组间统计上无差异。八项测量指标在调整长度和词汇频率后依然显著。通过测试集特征选择，形态学达到了宏观F1值0.85，与句法相当且高于微调的BERT（五个种子中平均0.80）；完全交叉验证选择给出了0.62。添加形态学提升了AUC（0.91 vs. 0.89）但未改善宏观F1值。迁移能力有限，尽管三分之二的效应在轻度认知障碍中保持了方向。结论：AD连贯语音表现出形态简化及时间重新锚定，而非功能丧失。形态学比其声誉所暗示的更具信息量。关键词：阿尔茨海默病；形态学；连贯语音；ADReSS；屈折；时态和体；SHAP；机器学习；BERT

articles.title: Lara Mini Base: Language Diversity as a Resource, Not a Trade-off

authors.name: Andrea Fernandez Tostado Ro. Diego Andrea

articles.abstract: General-purpose language models are trained mostly on English: over open models we review, at most, non-English pretraining data makes up only a 12% share. Models built for European languages give them far more, but score well below general-purpose models of the same size. A common concern is that, in small models, languages compete for capacity. We present Lara Mini base, a model trained from scratch on 6T tokens in English and 44 other languages, which together cover all 24 official languages of the European Union. As training progresses, the 44 other languages together come to outweigh English. To give these languages enough capacity at low cost, Lara Mini base uses a mixture of experts architecture with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters. Among open base models with up to 2B active parameters, it achieves the highest average score across standard English, multilingual, math, and code benchmarks, ahead of models trained on 4 to 6 times as many tokens. Its margin is largest on multilingual benchmarks in the languages it supports and on math benchmarks. It supports contexts of up to 128k tokens. We find that our MoE architecture reduces capacity competition between languages. For a single user on one GPU, without quantization, it generates text at least 1.8 times faster than any model with a higher average score. We release the weights of Lara Mini base under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license. In addition, we will release T-HellaSwag, a higher-quality machine translation of the commonsense reasoning benchmark HellaSwag into 110 language variants.
articles.titleCn: Lara迷你基地：语言多样性是一种资源，而非权衡
articles.abstractCn: 通用语言模型主要在英语上训练：在我们审查的开放模型中，最多只有12%的非英语预训练数据。为欧洲语言构建的模型则分配了更多资源，但同规模的通用模型得分却远低于它们。一个普遍的担忧是，在小模型中，语言会争夺容量。我们提出了Lara Mini base模型，该模型在英语和44种其他语言上从头开始训练，这些语言共同涵盖了欧盟的24种官方语言。随着训练的进行，其他44种语言的总容量最终超过了英语。为了以低成本为这些语言提供足够的容量，Lara Mini base采用了混合专家架构，总参数量为7.2B，活跃参数量为0.6B。在活跃参数量最高达2B的开放基础模型中，它在标准英语、多语言、数学和代码基准测试中取得了最高的平均得分，领先于在4到6倍于其参数量的数据上训练的模型。它的优势在它所支持的多语言基准测试和数学基准测试中最为显著。它支持高达128k个token的上下文。我们发现我们的MoE架构减少了语言之间的容量竞争。对于单个用户在单个GPU上，在不进行量化处理的情况下，它的文本生成速度至少比任何平均得分更高的模型快1.8倍。我们在CC BY-NC-SA 4.0许可证下发布了Lara Mini base的权重。此外，我们还将发布T-HellaSwag，这是一种更高质量的常识推理基准测试HellaSwag翻译成110种语言变体的机器翻译。

articles.title: SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection
articles.abstract: The easy access to Large Language Models (LLMs) has made AI-generated texts on the web increasingly ubiquitous, making AI-text detection a crucial task. Prompts greatly influence the generation process, but existing detectors focus solely on the generated texts --- supervised methods learn from labeled texts only, and zero-shot methods rely on the text's probability distributions --- ignoring the underlying generation process, which limits their robustness in open-world scenarios. We introduce SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection, a novel framework for detecting AI-generated text that transfers better across datasets. Specifically, we measure the prompt's influence and use it as a discriminative signal. We characterize the prompt's influence by introducing a Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) term that captures how much a prompt explains a text. Based on this quantity, SPADE trains one soft prompt per class to amplify the separation, and predicts the class whose prompt best explains the candidate text. Extensive experiments on several benchmarks against various detectors demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our method, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets.
articles.titleCn: SPADE：用于人工智能文本检测的软提示
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的便捷访问使得网络上的AI生成文本日益普遍，使得AI文本检测成为一项关键任务。提示词对生成过程有很大影响，但现有的检测器仅关注生成的文本——监督方法仅从标记文本中学习，零样本方法依赖文本的概率分布——忽略了底层的生成过程，这限制了它们在开放世界场景中的鲁棒性。我们介绍了SPADE：用于AI文本检测的软提示词，这是一个能够更好地跨数据集迁移的新型检测框架。具体而言，我们测量了提示词的影响，并将其用作判别信号。我们通过引入一个点互信息（PMI）项来表征提示词的影响，该项捕捉了提示词解释文本的程度。基于这一量度，SPADE为每个类别训练一个软提示词来放大区分度，并预测最能解释候选文本的类别。在多个基准数据集上与各种检测器进行的广泛实验表明，我们方法的鲁棒性和有效性，并在分布外（OOD）数据集上实现了最先进（SOTA）的性能。

articles.title: Beyond Word Error Rate: A Failure Taxonomy of Streaming Dictation ASR
articles.abstract: Speech recognition (ASR) systems are usually compared by word error rate (WER) on recorded files, after punctuation, capital letters and number format are removed. In dictation, the audio is streamed live and the text goes into the user's message as written, so what matters is which mistakes the user has to fix. The test set, streamed to eleven ASR systems, comprises 106 scripted English dictations from one speaker (read in a quiet room, with a fan on, and whispered), 20 clips in each of eleven other language and dialect sets, and 400 recordings that join clips in two languages. Every error was sorted by a fixed rule into four levels: recognition, output formatting, language handling and, for the self-hosted models, audio dropped before the model. Systems with similar WER failed in different ways. Zoom Scribe and OpenAI's GPT-Live-Transcribe have almost the same WER on quiet English (7.4% and 7.3%), but 34.7% and 8.8% on whispered English. Zoom and both AssemblyAI models left out 26-28% of whispered words, and still 21-26% with their end-of-turn detection relaxed or off; seven other systems left out at most 3%. Qwen3-ASR's 32% came from the speech detection in our own deployment (6% when relaxed). Across 107 EARS speakers, the same four systems lost 7-31% of whispered words, while six others lost under 2%. With only English selected, Gemini, Deepgram and our self-hosted Whisper lost the non-English part of a two-language recording in 86-99% of recordings, against 33-46% with both languages selected, while GPT-Live-Transcribe, OpenAI's realtime Whisper and Meta lost it in at most 20%. Running Whisper behind a Silero voice activity detector that drops audio judged to be silence raised whispered WER from 10.1% to 51.4%. Most English results come from one read speaker. The code, the recordings, both references and every transcript are released.
articles.titleCn: 超越词错误率：流式语音转文字ASR的失效分类
articles.abstractCn: 语音识别（ASR）系统通常在移除标点、大写字母和数字格式后的录音文件上通过词错误率（WER）进行比较。在听写场景中，音频实时流式传输，文本按用户书写的方式进入消息，因此关键在于用户需要修正哪些错误。测试集被流式传输到11个ASR系统，包含一位说话者（在安静房间内、有风扇、低语状态下）的106段脚本英语听写，其他11种语言和方言集各20段片段，以及400段包含两种语言片段的录音。每个错误根据固定规则被分为四个等级：识别错误、输出格式错误、语言处理错误，以及对于自托管模型，模型在音频丢失前的处理。WER相似的系统以不同的方式失败。Zoom Scribe和OpenAI的GPT-Live-Transcribe在安静英语上的WER几乎相同（分别为7.4%和7.3%），但在低语英语上分别为34.7%和8.8%。Zoom和两个AssemblyAI模型遗漏了26-28%的低语单词，即使放宽或关闭回合结束检测，仍遗漏21-26%；其他七个系统最多遗漏3%。Qwen3-ASR的32%错误来自我们自部署的语音检测（放宽时为6%）。在107位EARS说话者中，这四个系统遗漏了7-31%的低语单词，而其他六个系统遗漏不足2%。仅选择英语时，Gemini、Deepgram和我们的自托管Whisper在86-99%的录音中丢失了双语言录音的非英语部分，而选择两种语言时为33-46%，GPT-Live-Transcribe、OpenAI的实时Whisper和Meta最多丢失20%。在Silero语音活动检测器后运行Whisper，将判断为静音的音频丢弃，将低语WER从10.1%提高到51.4%。大多数英语结果来自一位朗读说话者。代码、录音、两个参考文本和所有转录文本均已公开。

articles.title: Human or Synthetic? What a Fixed Budget Buys for Post-Training
articles.abstract: Post-training of large language models typically combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with preference-based fine-tuning such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Human-annotated and synthetically generated preference data differ substantially in per-sample cost, but prior work typically holds sample count fixed when comparing the two. In this work, we explicitly study the interplay between cost and performance by comparing the effect of post-training with human and synthetic preference data under a fixed, dollar-matched annotation budget. We train and evaluate multiple base model families across helpfulness and summarization tasks. We find that synthetic data is far more cost-efficient at low-to-moderate budgets, achieving high win rates with as little as \$200--\$400. On helpfulness, human data closes the gap only at budgets roughly two orders of magnitude larger; on summarization, it does not close the gap at any tested budget. We also find that human-annotated data varies in reliability: one widely used human preference source substantially underperforms another, and the gap persists even after standard remedies such as domain restriction and deduplication.
articles.titleCn: 人类还是合成？固定预算在训练后能买到什么？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的训练后微调通常结合监督微调（SFT）与基于偏好的微调，例如直接偏好优化（DPO）。人工标注和合成生成的偏好数据在每样本成本上存在显著差异，但以往研究在比较两者时通常固定样本数量。本研究明确通过在固定、美元匹配的标注预算下比较使用人工和合成偏好数据进行训练后微调的效果，研究成本与性能之间的相互作用。我们在有益性和摘要生成任务上训练和评估了多个基础模型家族。我们发现，在低至中等预算下，合成数据远比人工数据更具成本效益，只需200至400美元即可实现高胜率。在有益性任务上，人工数据仅在预算大约大两个数量级时才缩小差距；在摘要生成任务上，无论测试何种预算，人工数据均未缩小差距。此外，我们发现人工标注数据的可靠性存在差异：一个广泛使用的人工偏好数据源表现远不如另一个，即使采用标准补救措施（如领域限制和去重）后，差距依然存在。

articles.title: Look It Up: Multi-bit LLM Watermarking via Codebook Search
articles.abstract: Attributing short LLM-generated texts to a specific source remains challenging for existing multi-bit watermarking methods, which often require long generations or costly decoding to recover payloads reliably. We propose a codebook-based watermarking scheme that maps an $n$-bit payload to a longer $u$-bit codeword and embeds it during generation through token-level logit biasing. During extraction, the received bit sequence is matched to the nearest codeword in a precomputed secret codebook using Hamming or Levenshtein distance. Experiments show that our method achieves near-perfect recovery for 16-24 bit payloads on 200-token generations and strong performance on 127-token generations for base models. Results are weaker on some instruction-tuned models with very short texts, where low-entropy output distributions reduce embedding reliability. We also study a BCH-based variant that avoids codebook storage but generally reduces robustness. The Levenshtein variant improves resilience to deletions and light paraphrasing, while insertions and stronger rewrites remain challenging. We analyze collision probability, codeword separation, extraction time, tokenization consistency, and text quality, highlighting both the practicality and limitations of codebook-based watermarking for short-form attribution.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security. Code: https://github.com/jaroslawjanas/llmw-codebook
articles.titleCn: 查找：基于码本搜索的多比特大型语言模型水印技术
articles.abstractCn: 将短文本LLM生成内容归因于特定来源对现有的多比特水印方法仍具挑战性，这些方法通常需要较长的生成或昂贵的解码才能可靠地恢复有效载荷。我们提出了一种基于码本的水印方案，该方案将n比特有效载荷映射为更长的u比特码字，并在生成过程中通过token级别的logit偏差嵌入。在提取阶段，接收到的比特序列通过汉明距离或莱文斯坦距离与预计算的密钥码本中的最近码字进行匹配。实验表明，我们的方法在200个token的生成中实现了16-24比特有效载荷的近乎完美恢复，并在基础模型上对127个token的生成表现出优异性能。然而，在一些指令微调模型上，对于非常短的文本，结果较弱，因为低熵输出分布降低了嵌入的可靠性。我们还研究了基于BCH的变体，该变体避免了码本存储，但通常降低了鲁棒性。莱文斯坦变体提高了对删除和轻微改写的抗干扰能力，但插入和强重写仍然具有挑战性。我们分析了碰撞概率、码字分离度、提取时间、分词一致性以及文本质量，突出了基于码本水印方法在短文本归因中的实用性和局限性。

articles.title: Pretraining Data Statistics Shape the Phases of Learning Entity Comparison in Language Models
articles.abstract: How does data shape language model (LM) behavior throughout pretraining? We investigate this question through a case study on entity comparison, e.g., Between France and Brazil, which country is larger?, across nine comparison tasks spanning five entity types. We begin with controlled experiments in which we train small LMs (163M parameters) on mixtures of natural text from pretraining corpora and synthetic task data. Our analysis identifies three distinct phases of learning: (1) an early phase where the LM selects entities by frequency, (2) a middle phase where the LM selects entities by position in the prompt (first vs. last mentioned entity), and (3) a late phase where the LM selects the entity that is the correct answer. We show that the emergence of these three phases is causally determined by statistical properties of the training data. With small amounts of task-specific synthetic data, we observe only the first two phases and the model fails to learn the task; with large amounts, the model jumps directly from the frequency-based heuristic to solving the task correctly. Moreover, changing the entity frequency distribution from a naturally occurring Zipfian distribution (a small number of entities are very common and the vast majority are rare) to a uniform one weakens the frequency phase and speeds up learning of the task. Lastly, we show that the three phases of training dynamics from our controlled experiments appear in the open source model OLMo-2 32B. Together, our findings demonstrate that properties of pretraining data are causal drivers of heuristic learning and show that small-scale synthetic experiments can predict training dynamics at larger scales.
articles.titleCn: 预训练数据统计塑造语言模型中实体比较学习的阶段
articles.abstractCn: 数据如何在预训练过程中塑造语言模型（LM）的行为？我们通过一个案例研究来探讨这个问题，该研究涉及实体比较，例如“在法国和巴西之间，哪个国家更大？”等九个涵盖五种实体类型的比较任务。我们首先进行受控实验，在实验中，我们使用预训练语料库中的自然文本和合成任务数据的混合来训练小型语言模型（1.63亿参数）。我们的分析确定了三个不同的学习阶段：（1）早期阶段，语言模型通过频率选择实体；（2）中期阶段，语言模型通过提示中的位置选择实体（第一个提到的实体与最后一个提到的实体）；（3）后期阶段，语言模型选择正确答案的实体。我们表明，这三个阶段的出现是由训练数据的统计特性决定的。使用少量特定任务的合成数据，我们只观察到前两个阶段，模型无法学习任务；而使用大量数据时，模型直接从基于频率的启发式方法跳到正确解决任务。此外，将实体频率分布从自然发生的齐夫分布（少数实体非常常见，绝大多数罕见）改为均匀分布，会削弱频率阶段并加速任务学习。最后，我们表明，我们受控实验中的三个训练动态阶段出现在开源模型OLMo-2 32B中。总的来说，我们的发现表明，预训练数据的特性是启发式学习的因果驱动因素，并且小规模的合成实验可以预测更大规模上的训练动态。

articles.title: Shortcuts or Memorisation? Revisiting Data Corruption in Natural Language Understanding with Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Pre-trained encoders fine-tuned on natural language inference (NLI) and other language understanding tasks keep much of their accuracy after the input is perturbed, e.g. by removing all nouns or shuffling the words. Does the same hold for large language models (LLMs), and if so, is it because they have seen the benchmarks during pre-training? In this paper we revisit these perturbation experiments with eight LLMs alongside fine-tuned encoders on GLUE and the three rounds of ANLI. Regardless of model size, every system that answers directly retains 36-72% of its above-chance performance without nouns on MNLI compared to only 14-29% on ANLI. Only a model that reasons before answering departs from this pattern. We also check contamination indicators (including exact $n$-gram counts in the public pre-training data of two of the models) and find no link between exposure and robustness. Our strongest evidence comes from 368 new, human-validated items that none of the models can have seen. All eight LLMs keep more of their performance without nouns on items written in MNLI's style than on items written without its cues. When the perturbation instead removes the function words carrying such cues, this advantage reverses. In light of these results, we argue that robustness to perturbation on familiar NLI benchmarks reflects dataset shortcuts rather than memorisation, and tells us more about the benchmark than about the model.
articles.titleCn: 捷径还是记忆？使用大型语言模型重新审视自然语言理解中的数据损坏
articles.abstractCn: 在自然语言推理（NLI）和其他语言理解任务上微调的预训练编码器在输入扰动后仍保持大部分准确率，例如移除所有名词或打乱单词顺序。这对大型语言模型（LLM）是否同样适用，以及这是否是因为它们在预训练期间接触过基准测试？在本文中，我们使用八个LLM以及GLUE和ANLI三轮微调编码器重新审视了这些扰动实验。无论模型大小如何，所有直接回答问题的系统在移除名词后，在MNLI上保留了36-72%的超出随机水平的性能，而在ANLI上仅为14-29%。只有先进行推理再回答的模型偏离了这一模式。我们还检查了污染指标（包括其中两个模型在公共预训练数据中的确切n-gram计数），发现暴露程度与鲁棒性之间没有关联。我们最有力的证据来自368个新的人验证项目，这些项目没有任何模型可能见过。所有八个LLM在MNLI风格的文本项目上比在未包含其提示的文本项目上保留了更多的性能，当扰动移除承载这些提示的功能词时，这种优势会逆转。基于这些结果，我们认为对熟悉NLI基准测试的扰动鲁棒性反映了数据集捷径而非记忆，更多地揭示了基准测试而非模型。

articles.title: Outcome-Mass Alignment: Controlling Length-Dependent Trajectory Influence in Multi-Turn LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: To keep long interaction contexts tractable, stepwise group-relative training for multi-turn LLM agents materializes each source trajectory into multiple response rows and valid tokens. This expansion creates an outer-accounting problem distinct from within-trajectory credit assignment: row-based outcome statistics can count one episode outcome multiple times, while token-level reduction can assign unequal aggregate objective mass across trajectories. We term these effects outcome-statistics multiplicity and objective-mass imbalance. We introduce Outcome-Mass Alignment (OMA), a two-component method that makes both accounting choices explicit. Outcome Alignment computes outcome statistics over unique source trajectories, while Mass Alignment controls aggregate objective mass after within-trajectory aggregation of optimizer-native token objectives. Neither redesigns the base optimizer's credit assignment, importance ratios, or clipping. Across matched ALFWorld GRPO comparisons at two model scales, where failed trajectories typically expand much more than successful ones, OMA improves matched-horizon endpoint success by 7.0-9.4 percentage points. Ordinary WebShop exhibits weak or reversed expansion-outcome coupling and correspondingly mixed effects, whereas in a success-oriented WebShop setting, WebShop-SOL, OMA improves success nAUC from 0.399 to 0.511. Component ablations and GiGPO and GSPO comparisons further support component separability and cross-optimizer compatibility. These results show that trajectory expansion always defines an implicit weighting rule, but its practical effect depends on how expansion couples to outcomes and optimizer-native updates.
articles.titleCn: 结果-质量对齐：控制多轮LLM智能体强化学习中的长度相关轨迹影响
articles.abstractCn: 为了保持长交互上下文的可管理性，多轮LLM代理的逐步分组相对训练将每个源轨迹转化为多个响应行和有效标记。这种扩展产生了与轨迹内信用分配不同的外部核算问题：基于行的结果统计数据可能会多次计算一个场景的结果，而标记级别的约简可以在不同轨迹之间分配不等的总目标质量。我们将这些效应称为结果统计数据多重性和目标质量不平衡。我们引入了结果质量对齐（OMA），这是一种包含两个组件的方法，使两种核算选择都明确化。结果对齐计算唯一源轨迹上的结果统计数据，而质量对齐在优化器原生的标记目标在轨迹内聚合后控制总目标质量。这两种方法都不会重新设计基础优化器的信用分配、重要性比率或裁剪。在两个模型规模下进行匹配的ALFWorld GRPO比较中，其中失败的轨迹通常比成功的轨迹扩展得多得多，OMA将匹配时间范围端点成功率提高了7.0-9.4个百分点。普通WebShop表现出微弱或反向的扩展-结果耦合，并相应地产生混合效应，而在以成功为导向的WebShop设置WebShop-SOL中，OMA将成功nAUC从0.399提高到0.511。组件消融和GiGPO与GSPO的比较进一步支持了组件可分离性和跨优化器兼容性。这些结果表明，轨迹扩展始终定义了一种隐式的加权规则，但其实际效果取决于扩展如何与结果和优化器原生更新耦合。

articles.title: Detection Is Not Early Warning: Evaluating Token-Level Alarms on Language Model Failures
articles.abstract: Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset. A monitor that reads the model during generation can classify the finished response, detect the failure once it is under way, or warn before it begins, and only a warning leaves time to stop or steer the generation. Monitors are usually evaluated with response-level metrics such as AUROC, which ignore when the monitor fires. We introduce PREWARN, an evaluation protocol for any failure with an annotated onset. It calibrates each monitor's threshold on validation data to an error rate chosen for the application, runs the monitor, and scores its alarms relative to the onset on all three tasks. As a case study we apply it to repetitive degeneration in three open language models, with early warning as the main task, using linear probes on activations and six untrained baselines. Response-level metrics saturate on this failure, and a rule that reads only the response length scores almost perfectly, while probes that AUROC ranks as equal warn very differently under PREWARN. Probes warn before the onset on most degenerate responses of two of the three models, low-rank adapters below the probe more than double the share of tokens just before the onset that it flags, largely by flagging degenerate responses long before the onset, and no untrained baseline warns much more often than random alarms. We release the probes with calibrated thresholds at https://huggingface.co/collections/marcodene/prewarn-degeneration-probes
articles.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability as a Science. 30 pages (10 main text), 6 figures, 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/swiss-ai/degeneration-probe
articles.titleCn: 检测并非预警：评估语言模型失效的词级警报
articles.abstractCn: 许多语言模型的失败往往始于特定的标记，即起始点。在生成过程中读取模型的监控器可以对最终响应进行分类，一旦失败开始即可检测，或在开始前发出警告，而只有警告才能留出时间停止或调整生成。监控器通常使用响应级指标（如AUROC）进行评估，这些指标忽略了监控器触发的时间。我们引入了PREWARN，这是一种用于任何具有标注起始点的失败的评估协议。它将每个监控器的阈值在验证数据上校准到应用中选择的错误率，运行监控器，并相对于起始点在所有三个任务中对监控器的警报进行评分。作为一个案例研究，我们将其应用于三个开源语言模型中的重复退化，以早期警告为主要任务，使用激活上的线性探针和六个未训练的基线。响应级指标在这个失败上达到饱和，而只读取响应长度的规则几乎完美地评分，而AUROC排名相同的探针在PREWARN下发出截然不同的警告。在三个模型中的两个模型的多数退化响应上，探针在起始点之前发出警告，低秩适配器在探针之下标记的起始点之前的标记份额超过了两倍，这主要是通过在起始点之前标记退化响应来实现的，并且没有未训练的基线比随机警报更频繁地发出警告。我们发布了校准阈值的探针，可在https://huggingface.co/collections/marcodene/prewarn-degeneration-probes获取。

articles.title: Towards Green Text Generation: Memory-Based Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates text generation with large language models by letting a cheap draft model propose tokens that a large verifier checks in a single forward pass. We introduce Olifant, a draft model built on a memory-based classifier. It predicts the next token from a four-token window in under 0.3 ms on CPU, requiring no GPU, no backpropagation, and no accelerator memory. We measure throughput and energy under two verifier regimes on consumer hardware. Without a KV cache, drafting is nearly free: a domain-matched Olifant model reaches 38.1% acceptance on EU legal text, delivering 2.43x throughput and 2.51x lower energy per token than the neural verifier model alone. With a KV-cached verifier, itself a ~10x energy saver, drafting costs matter: a TinyLlama draft model halves throughput and triples energy despite high acceptance, whereas Olifant still yields 1.25x throughput and the lowest energy in the study (93 J per 100 tokens, 14x below the uncached baseline). We further show that KV caching decouples time from energy: verification of longer drafts raises power draw, shifting the energy-optimal draft length below the speed-optimal one. Speculative decoding is not dead in the age of fast verifiers, provided drafting is nearly free.
