articles.titleCn: 面向绿色文本生成：基于记忆的推测解码
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码通过让一个成本较低的草稿模型在单次前向传递中提出令大模型验证器检查的标记，从而加速大型语言模型的文本生成。我们引入了Olifant，这是一个基于基于内存分类器的草稿模型。它在CPU上从四标记窗口中预测下一个标记，耗时不到0.3毫秒，无需GPU、无需反向传播、无需加速器内存。我们在消费级硬件上测量了两种验证器模式下的吞吐量和能耗。在没有KV缓存的情况下，草稿几乎免费：一个与领域匹配的Olifant模型在欧盟法律文本上达到38.1%的接受率，其吞吐量比单独的神经验证器模型高2.43倍，每标记能耗低2.51倍。在有KV缓存的验证器的情况下，本身能省电约10倍的草稿成本变得重要：尽管TinyLlama草稿模型接受率高，但吞吐量减半，能耗增加三倍，而Olifant仍然保持1.25倍的吞吐量和研究中最低的能耗（每100标记93焦耳，比未缓存基线低14倍）。我们进一步表明，KV缓存使时间和能耗解耦：验证更长的草稿会提高功耗，将能耗最优的草稿长度推至速度最优长度之下。在快速验证器的时代，只要草稿几乎免费，推测解码并未过时。

articles.title: Forecasting Sales Delay through Time-aware Analysis of Sales Events in Textual Reports
articles.abstract: Business-to-business (B2B) companies develop and deliver a one-of-a-kind product in response to a client's orders. To prepare resources for development beforehand, companies estimate dates when they will receive orders from clients in their sales process, called scheduled order dates. However, dates when the companies actually receive orders can differ from the scheduled order dates. This difference increases costs in the development. If the difference could be forecasted before receiving orders, companies could optimize their resource preparation. Towards reducing the costs, we introduce sales delay forecasting, a novel task of forecasting delay days from the scheduled order dates during sales process where sales representatives (sales reps) interact with the clients to receive orders. Sales delay forecasting is challenging because the sales process progress inherently involves uncertainty and depends on the client's willingness to order. To address this task, we propose confidence features which represent sales reps' confidence as a proxy measure of the client's willingness to order. To represent it, our method extracts dates of future sales events anticipated by sales reps from textual reports. To consider whether the confidence objectively looks reasonable, we also introduce status features which describe sales process status based on current date and past events. In experiments using real sales data, our method achieved a 16% lower mean absolute error compared with a feature-based baseline similar to a prior work. Moreover, our method outperformed non-feature-based baselines using large language models, indicating that it is crucial to explicitly create our features.
articles.titleCn: 通过文本报告中销售事件的时间感知分析预测销售延迟
articles.abstractCn: 企业对企业（B2B）公司根据客户的订单开发和交付独一无二的产品。为了事先准备开发资源，公司会预估其销售流程中从客户处接收订单的日期，称为计划订单日期。然而，公司实际接收订单的日期可能与计划订单日期存在差异。这种差异会增加开发成本。如果能在接收订单前预测这种差异，公司就能优化其资源准备。为了降低成本，我们引入了销售延迟预测，这是一项新任务，旨在预测销售流程中销售代表（销售代表）与客户互动以接收订单时，从计划订单日期起的延迟天数。销售延迟预测具有挑战性，因为销售流程的进展本质上涉及不确定性，并取决于客户的订购意愿。为了应对这一任务，我们提出了置信度特征，这些特征代表了销售代表的信心，作为衡量客户订购意愿的代理指标。为了表示这一点，我们的方法从文本报告中提取销售代表预期的未来销售事件日期。为了考虑置信度是否客观合理，我们还引入了状态特征，这些特征基于当前日期和过去事件来描述销售流程状态。在真实销售数据的实验中，我们的方法与类似先前工作的基于特征的基线相比，平均绝对误差降低了16%。此外，我们的方法优于使用大型语言模型的非基于特征的基线，表明明确创建我们的特征至关重要。

articles.title: When Expert Disagreement Hurts: Prestige and Selectivity in LLM Decision Revision
articles.abstract: When language models revise a decision after another agent disagrees, neither reversal counts nor final accuracy shows whether they are fixing mistakes or abandoning correct answers. We introduce a controlled two-pass audit that holds the question, the evidence, and the model's initial answer fixed and varies only the revision context: neutral reflection, anonymous disagreement, or disagreement attributed to a domain expert. For binary decisions the accounting is exact: revision raises accuracy only if it is selective enough, reversing wrong answers more than $a/(1-a)$ times as often as correct ones, where $a$ is initial accuracy (nine times at 90%). Across five models and 1,989 evidence-grounded decisions in medicine, science, and law, no model clears this bar under expert disagreement, and accuracy falls by up to 16.1 points. The expert label, a prestige cue, adds reversals for four of the five models, yet its effect on accuracy ranges from a 5.2-point loss to a 2.4-point gain, so reversal counts are a poor proxy for harm. With identical arguments from both sources, the label still raises reversal for three proprietary models and in a pooled analysis of four newer models. Models also respond to stated source reliability. Revision pipelines should therefore be evaluated with paired, conditional metrics, per model and protocol.
articles.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 38 pages, 7 figures, 36 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/yupengtang/when-expert-disagreement-hurts
articles.titleCn: 当专家意见分歧造成伤害：大型语言模型决策修正中的声望与选择性
articles.abstractCn: 当语言模型在另一个智能体提出异议后修改决策时，无论是反转次数还是最终准确率都无法判断它们是在修正错误还是在放弃正确答案。我们引入了一种受控的两阶段审计方法，将问题、证据和模型的初始答案固定，仅改变修订背景：中立反思、匿名异议或归因于领域专家的异议。对于二元决策，审计结果精确：修订只有在足够具有选择性时才会提高准确率，即反转错误答案的频率超过正确答案的$a/(1-a)$倍，其中$a$为初始准确率（在90%时为九倍）。在医学、科学和法律领域五个模型中的1,989个基于证据的决策中，没有模型在专家异议下达到这一标准，准确率最多下降16.1分。专家标签作为一种声望信号，使五个模型中的四个产生反转，但其对准确率的影响从损失5.2分到收益2.4分不等，因此反转次数是衡量损害的糟糕指标。当两个来源提供相同的论据时，标签仍使三个专有模型产生反转，在四个较新模型的合并分析中也存在相同现象。模型还会响应声明的来源可靠性。因此，修订流程应使用针对模型和协议的配对条件指标进行评估。

articles.title: MuSeToM: Multi-Sensory Evaluation of Belief Revision with Textual Cues Across Six Senses
articles.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer mental states in others, is pivotal for human social cognition. Existing evaluations of ToM in large language models (LLMs) mainly focus on static belief attribution and false-belief reasoning, leaving a critical aspect of social reasoning underexplored: can LLMs decide whether perceptual evidence is sufficient to justify another person's belief revision? To address this gap, we present MuSeToM, a human-validated, text-based benchmark for evaluating epistemic belief revision in ToM reasoning. MuSeToM contains 2,415 instances adapted from BigToM and OpenToM, with textual cues spanning six sensory categories, and tests whether models can determine when a protagonist should revise a belief and infer the resulting updated belief state. Using MuSeToM, we systematically evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs under direct and chain-of-thought prompting, revealing a pronounced dissonance: while models often detect that a belief may change, they struggle to identify the updated belief and frequently over-update on perceptually salient but epistemically insufficient cues.
articles.titleCn: MuSeToM：基于文本线索的六感信念修正多感官评估
articles.abstractCn: 心智理论（Theory of Mind, ToM），即推断他人心理状态的能力，是人类社会认知的关键。目前对大型语言模型（LLMs）中的心智理论的评估主要集中于静态信念归因和错误信念推理，而忽略了社会推理的一个关键方面：LLMs能否判断感知证据是否足以证明他人信念的修正？为填补这一空白，我们提出了MuSeToM，一个经过人类验证的、基于文本的基准，用于评估心智理论推理中的认知信念修正。MuSeToM包含从BigToM和OpenToM改编的2,415个实例，其中文本线索涵盖六个感官类别，并测试模型能否判断主角何时应修正信念以及推断由此产生的更新信念状态。使用MuSeToM，我们在直接提示和思维链提示下系统地评估了最先进的LLMs，揭示了一个显著的矛盾：虽然模型通常能检测到信念可能发生变化，但它们难以识别更新后的信念，并且在感知上显著但认知上不足的线索上频繁过度更新。

articles.title: Unibuc - NLP at "Voight-Kampff" Generative AI Detection PAN 2025
articles.abstract: This paper describes the approach of the Unibuc - NLP team in tackling the "Voight-Kampff" Generative AI Detection task from PAN at CLEF 2025. In the Subtask 1: Voight-Kampff AI Detection Sensitivity we have explored different approaches of leveraging embeddings extracted from LLMs, using either classical ML models or further fine-tuning LLMs with a classification head for the downstream binary classification task. Our experiments showed that using a majority vote ensemble of classical ML models (Light GBM, XGB, Logistic Regression and SVM) is comparable with fine-tuning for downstream task achieving around 99.4% F1 score. For the Subtask 2: Human-AI Collaborative Text Classification we explored a way of combining features at different layers extracted using transformer backbone with layer-wise projection and attentive pooling which proved modest results.
articles.titleCn: Unibuc - 在“沃伊特-坎普夫”生成式人工智能检测中，自然语言处理 PAN 2025
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了Unibuc-NLP团队在处理CLEF 2025 PAN会议“Voight-Kampff”生成式AI检测任务中的方法。在子任务1：Voight-Kampff AI检测敏感性方面，我们探索了利用从大型语言模型（LLM）中提取的嵌入的不同方法，使用经典机器学习模型或进一步用分类头对LLM进行微调以进行下游二元分类任务。我们的实验表明，使用经典机器学习模型（Light GBM、XGB、逻辑回归和SVM）的多数投票集成与下游任务的微调相当，达到了约99.4%的F1分数。在子任务2：人-AI协作文本分类方面，我们探索了结合使用transformer主干网络提取的不同层级的特征，通过层级投影和注意力池化相结合的方法，该方法取得了适度结果。

articles.title: Do the Details Help the Whole? One-Way Transfer from Person Actions to Group Intent in VLMs on JRDB-Social
articles.abstract: Social scene datasets label people at two levels: what each person is doing and what the group is there for. Training on both levels at once is often assumed to help each of them. We test this assumption for vision-language models (VLMs) on JRDB-Social, treating person actions as the details and group intent as the whole. We fine-tune Qwen3.5 4B under eight training arms with three seeds, repeat the core arms on Qwen3.5 9B and Qwen3-VL 4B, and judge every arm with a verdict rule fixed before testing. Writing each member's actions before the intent raises intent macro-F1 from 30.1 to 31.0, and writing the intent first reaches 31.2, while action F1 stays within 0.2 points of an action-only model. Under the selected recipe, no arm trained with intent improves actions. The gain requires correct, image-grounded actions: empty action lists or actions borrowed from another group with the same intent lower intent F1. Forced-prefix tests, occlusion, member masking, linear probes and component grafting show that the intent follows the written actions, relies more on people and partly resides in the vision tower. Supplying actions as input instead of as targets hurts both levels.
articles.titleCn: 细节有助于整体吗？在JRDB-Social上的VLMs中从个人行为到群体意图的单向转移
articles.abstractCn: 社交场景数据集在两个层次上标注人物：每个人正在做什么以及这个群体为何在此。通常假设同时在这两个层次上训练有助于提升各自的表现。我们在JRDB-Social上针对视觉语言模型（VLMs）测试了这一假设，将人物行为视为细节，将群体意图视为整体。我们使用三个种子在八种训练配置下微调Qwen3.5 4B，并在Qwen3.5 9B和Qwen3-VL 4B上重复核心配置，并在测试前使用固定的评判规则对每种配置进行评估。在意图标注前先标注每个成员的行为可将意图宏观F1从30.1提升至31.0，而先标注意图则能达到31.2，同时行为F1保持在仅标注行为的模型上下0.2的范围内。在选定的配置下，未使用意图标注的训练配置无法提升行为标注效果。该提升需要正确且基于图像的行为标注：空的行为列表或从具有相同意图的其他群体中借用的行为会降低意图F1。强制前缀测试、遮挡、成员掩码、线性探针和组件嫁接实验表明，意图遵循标注的行为，更依赖人物信息，部分存在于视觉塔中。将行为作为输入而非目标输入会同时损害两个层次的表现。

articles.title: Lost in Delegation: Studying the Effectiveness of Task Orchestration in Generative Search
articles.abstract: LLMs have quickly evolved from models used in isolation to agentic systems that delegate tasks to external tools and other LLMs to solve complex assignments. This agentic augmentation has led to impressive capability gains. However, when and how delegation improves performance remains poorly understood. For example, it is unclear whether delegation helps when tasks involve post-cutoff information that the orchestrating LLM cannot reliably resolve from its own knowledge. In this work, we use purpose-built datasets with pre- and post-cutoff splits to compare various delegation modes. We find that delegation provides no consistent accuracy improvement over non-delegated setups, with effects varying across models and tasks. When tasks involve knowledge unavailable to the orchestrator, delegation can substantially degrade accuracy, while direct tool use with the same LLM performs much better. Our analysis identifies distorted delegated queries, inefficient tool use, and failures to preserve and use information between agents as recurring failure modes. These findings suggest that effective orchestration requires both well-calibrated delegation decisions and effective exchange of information between agents.
articles.titleCn: 迷失于委托：研究生成式搜索中任务编排的有效性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已迅速从孤立使用的模型演变为能够将任务委托给外部工具和其他LLMs来解决复杂任务的代理系统。这种代理能力的增强带来了显著的性能提升。然而，委托何时以及如何提升性能仍然知之甚少。例如，当任务涉及截止日期后信息时，委托是否有助于解决这些信息 orchestrating LLM无法从自身知识中可靠解析的情况尚不明确。在这项工作中，我们使用具有截止日期前后分割的定制数据集来比较各种委托模式。我们发现，与未委托设置相比，委托并未提供一致的准确率提升，其效果因模型和任务而异。当任务涉及orchestrator无法获取的知识时，委托会显著降低准确率，而使用相同LLM的直接工具调用则表现远好。我们的分析识别出委托查询失真、工具使用效率低下以及代理间信息保存和使用失败等反复出现的失效模式。这些发现表明，有效的协调需要良好的委托决策和代理间信息有效交换。

articles.title: EvenVLM: A Text and Multimodal Dataset for the Even Language with Vision-Language Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: We present EvenVLM, the first text and multimodal (VQA) dataset for Even (Lamut), an endangered Northern Tungusic language spoken by approximately 6,800 people in Siberia. Our dataset comprises 50,521 structured Even-Russian entries extracted from dictionary and phrasebook sources via GPT-4o Mini-based parsing, from which we synthetically generate 107,543 training examples spanning translation, grammar, reading comprehension, and semantic classification. To address tokenization inefficiency on Even's agglutinative morphology, we propose a three-step tokenizer expansion algorithm that adds Even-specific graphemes (eng, oe, o-umlaut), whitelisted vocabulary, and BPE merges, reducing average tokens per word by 27% (4.99 to 3.64). Using LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-VL-4B, we adapt the model for text tasks (0.53% trainable parameters, rank 32) and separately for visual question answering (rank 64, frozen vision encoder). Our best configuration achieves 11.4% exact match and a 13.6 weighted score on text benchmarks, 0.1283 chrF for sentence translation, and 65% accuracy on VQA (up from 0% for the base model and text-only fine-tuning). We release our datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and training pipeline to support further research on Even and other low-resource languages.
articles.comment: Published in Proceedings of the Workshop on Open Reasoning Across Cultures Languages (ORACLE) at EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: EvenVLM：一个用于Even语言的文本和多模态数据集，支持视觉-语言微调
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了EvenVLM，这是首个针对濒危的北方通古斯语系语言Even（拉穆特语）的文本和多模态（视觉问答）数据集，该语言在西伯利亚由约6,800人使用。我们的数据集包含50,521条结构化的Even-俄语条目，这些条目通过基于GPT-4o Mini的解析从词典和短语集中提取，并从中综合生成了107,543个训练示例，涵盖翻译、语法、阅读理解和语义分类。为解决Even粘着形态学上的分词效率问题，我们提出了一种三步分词器扩展算法，该算法添加了Even特定的图形符号（eng、oe、o-变音符号）、白名单词汇和BPE合并，将每个词的平均分词数减少了27%（从4.99降至3.64）。我们使用Qwen3-VL-4B的LoRA微调，将模型适配于文本任务（可训练参数0.53%，排名第32）和视觉问答任务（冻结视觉编码器，排名第64）。我们的最佳配置在文本基准测试中实现了11.4%的精确匹配和13.6的加权分数，句子翻译的chrF得分为0.1283，视觉问答准确率达到65%（相较于基础模型和仅文本微调的0%）。我们发布了我们的数据集、评估基准和训练流程，以支持对Even及其他低资源语言进一步的研究。

articles.title: Where in the Input Does a One-Pass Decision Encoder Look?
articles.abstract: Laya is a small model that answers a multiple-choice question about a text in one pass: the question, the options (each with a name and a description) and the text form one sequence of at most 512 tokens, the window, in the English release. A longer text is silently cut at the end, and we measure what that costs. Test documents place a held-out row's text, the evidence, at a chosen token offset among distractor text; 177 items, five tasks, three checkpoints (released, short-row fine-tune, long-document fine-tune), four window sizes and 93,275 scored requests. When the evidence lies beyond the window, accuracy falls to 26.4% for the released checkpoint (27.2% for both fine-tunes), near the 27.0% of guessing and below the 35.6% of always giving the commonest label. Confidence gives no warning (AUROC 0.50 to 0.55 for telling cut from read requests; 0.5 = chance), and the runtime's truncation flag also fires on requests whose evidence was visible. The released checkpoint reads visible evidence badly once text precedes it: 38.5% pooled against 60% when the evidence comes first, so a larger window alone gains +6.2 points. Fine-tuning on long documents adds +27.6 points on visible evidence over the short-row fine-tune (95% interval +22.3 to +33.1) and nothing on cut evidence. That is an in-family result: training rows and test documents share generator and question types, and the main filler is of the training kind. With encyclopedic filler never seen in training the gain is +13.2 (+9.9 to +16.6), with rows of other tasks as filler -2.0. Among training-free rearrangements a 312-token window scan helps most (+11.9 points over the default for the released checkpoint) at six to eleven forward passes. Documents are synthetic, labels are LLM-made and one backbone is studied, so these diagnose this model, not long documents in general.
articles.titleCn: 一个单次决策编码器在输入中查看的位置是什么？
articles.abstractCn: Laya是一个小型模型，它通过一次遍历来回答关于文本的多项选择题：问题、选项（每个选项都有名称和描述）和文本形成一个最多512个token的序列，即窗口。在英文版本中，较长的文本会在末尾被静默地截断，我们测量了这样做的影响。测试文档将保留行的文本（证据）放置在干扰文本中选择的位置；共177个项目，五个任务，三个检查点（发布版本、短行微调、长文档微调），四种窗口大小和93,275个评分请求。当证据位于窗口之外时，发布版本的准确率降至26.4%（微调版本的准确率为27.2%），接近猜测的27.0%，低于始终给出最常见标签的35.6%。置信度不会发出警告（区分截断请求和读取请求的AUROC为0.50至0.55；0.5=随机概率），并且运行时的截断标志也会在证据可见的请求上触发。发布版本的检查点在文本出现在证据之前时读取可见证据效果不佳：当证据首先出现时，38.5%的池化效果与60%的对比，因此仅增大窗口就能提高+6.2分。在长文档上微调比短行微调在可见证据上提高了+27.6分（95%置信区间+22.3至+33.1），但在截断证据上没有提升。这是一个家族内部的结果：训练行和测试文档共享生成器和问题类型，主要的填充内容是训练类型的。在训练中从未见过的百科填充内容提高了+13.2（+9.9至+16.6），而其他任务行作为填充内容则降低了-2.0。在无需训练的重新排列中，312个token的窗口扫描效果最好（比发布版本的默认设置高+11.9分），在六到十一次正向遍历中最为有效。文档是合成的，标签由大型语言模型生成，只研究了一个主干网络，因此这些结果诊断的是这个模型，而不是长文档的一般情况。

articles.title: How Should Planning Agents ReSHAPE Their Search Space?
articles.abstract: Planning agents and benchmarks treat a user's initial specification as fixed. Yet the requests users write exclude plans they would gladly take, since they rarely discover the possible trade-offs they would accept until seeing the options. Agents already revise requests through interaction, but whether this helps planning is unknown. We formalize this step as the ReSHAPE task, which judges a revision by whether its search space matches the acceptable plans and a planner finds one there. Using ReSHAPE Planter, which builds instances from planning benchmarks with a human-validated simulated user, we analyze 5,800 agent-revised specifications in travel and shopping. We find that reshaping matters: one correct trade-off makes the same planner reach an acceptable plan up to 4.6x as often, and search space quality predicts what the planner finds. Current agents, however, admit at most 32% of the acceptable plans, where that trade-off alone admits over 52%, because they ask about preferences instead of showing plans; in travel, showing plans raises F1 by 9.7 points over asking, with two model families. Planning agents should thus treat a request as a hypothesis to test against the user's reactions to concrete plans to recognize user trade-offs.
articles.titleCn: 规划代理应该如何重塑其搜索空间？
articles.abstractCn: 规划代理和基准将用户的初始规格视为固定不变。然而，用户编写的请求会排除他们愿意接受的方案，因为他们很少在看到选项之前发现他们愿意接受的权衡。代理已经通过交互来修改请求，但这是否有助于规划尚不清楚。我们将这一步骤形式化为ReSHAPE任务，该任务通过判断其搜索空间是否与可接受的方案匹配，并且规划器能在其中找到一个方案来评估修改。使用ReSHAPE Planter（该工具从规划基准中构建实例，并使用经过人类验证的模拟用户），我们分析了旅行和购物领域中5,800个代理修改的规格。我们发现修改至关重要：一个正确的权衡使同一规划器能够以高达4.6倍的频率找到可接受的方案，并且搜索空间的质量预测了规划器能找到的内容。然而，当前的代理最多只接受32%的可接受方案，而这一权衡单独就能接受超过52%的方案，因为它们询问偏好而不是展示方案；在旅行领域，展示方案比询问偏好使F1指标提高了9.7分，涉及两个模型系列。因此，规划代理应将请求视为一个假设，通过用户对具体方案的反应来测试，以识别用户的权衡。

articles.title: daVinci-Prover: Agent-Native Mid-Training for Formal Theorem Proving
articles.abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming formal theorem proving. Yet further progress remains constrained by the lack of a transparent and effective data recipe for systematically improving theorem-proving models. In this work, we argue that effective agentic provers require strong mathematical skill priors to ground theorem proving and agentic trajectories to enable long-horizon, interactive proof construction. To this end, we synthesize an agent-native 33.7B-token mid-training corpus covering decomposition, search, self-verification, and revision, together with verifier-grounded agentic trajectories. We further introduce the daVinci-Prover harness, which enables models to construct proofs and interact with a Lean verifier in an isolated workspace, and use it to collect approximately 36K high-quality agent trajectories for supervised fine-tuning. Our mid-training recipe yields an average improvement of 13.7 points over the matched Qwen3-8B SFT-only baseline across MiniF2F, FATE-M, and ProofNet. When applied to the Qwen3.5 series, our approach also yields strong performance across theorem-proving benchmarks and achieves near-saturating MiniF2F performance with memory compaction. The results highlight agent-native mid-training as an effective foundation for developing stronger interactive theorem-proving agents.
articles.titleCn: 达芬奇证明器：面向智能体的中训练阶段形式化定理证明
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的进步正迅速改变形式化定理证明。然而，进一步的发展仍受限于缺乏透明且有效的数据配方，以系统性地改进定理证明模型。在本工作中，我们主张有效的代理证明者需要强大的数学技能先验知识来支撑定理证明，以及代理轨迹来支持长时程、交互式的证明构建。为此，我们合成了一个包含分解、搜索、自我验证和修订的33.7B令牌的中间训练语料库，以及验证者指导的代理轨迹。我们进一步引入了daVinci-Prover框架，该框架使模型能够在隔离的工作空间中构建证明并与Lean验证器交互，并使用它收集了约36K个高质量的代理轨迹用于监督微调。我们的中间训练配方在MiniF2F、FATE-M和ProofNet上比匹配的Qwen3-8B SFT-only基线平均提高了13.7分。当应用于Qwen3.5系列时，我们的方法在定理证明基准测试中也表现出色，并通过内存压缩实现了近饱和的MiniF2F性能。这些结果突显了代理原生的中间训练是开发更强交互式定理证明代理的有效基础。

articles.title: RMIT-ADM+S at TREC RAG 2026: Research Agents, Retriever Ablations, and Open-Weight Replication
articles.abstract: We describe the RMIT-ADM+S team's participation in the TREC 2026 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) track using the ClimbMix corpus. We submitted seven research-agent runs using proprietary OpenAI and open-weight models, exploring different retrieval strategies, writer models, and agent workflows. Pre-submission ablations identified writer selection and adjacent-chunk expansion as the main factors affecting answer quality. In the official NIST evaluation, six of seven runs exceeded the track median across all three rubric/nugget collections. Our best-performing run, brief-hybrid, achieved the highest all-item coverage among our submissions and tied the track maximum (0.892) for Batch-1 vital coverage. Human side-by-side preferences differed across evaluation batches: the open-weight owa-glm5 led Batch 1 despite lower automated coverage, while sol-research-first led Batch 2. These findings highlight differences between automated coverage measures and human preferences, as well as the potential of lower-cost open-weight models for research-agent systems.
articles.titleCn: RMIT-ADM+S 在 TREC RAG 2026：研究代理、检索器消融和开放权重复制
articles.abstractCn: 我们描述了RMIT-ADM+S团队使用ClimbMix语料库参与TREC 2026检索增强生成（RAG）赛道的参赛情况。我们提交了七次研究代理运行，使用了专有OpenAI和开放权重模型，探索了不同的检索策略、写作模型和代理工作流程。提交前的消融实验确定了写作模型选择和相邻块扩展是影响答案质量的主要因素。在官方NIST评估中，七次运行中有六次在三个评估标准/信息片段集合中均超过了赛道中位数。我们表现最佳的运行（brief-hybrid）在我们的提交中实现了最高项覆盖率，并在Batch-1关键覆盖率中与赛道最高分（0.892）持平。人类对比评估在不同批次中存在差异：尽管自动化覆盖率较低，开放权重owa-glm5模型在Batch 1中表现最佳，而sol-research-first模型在Batch 2中表现最佳。这些发现突显了自动化覆盖率指标与人类偏好之间的差异，以及低成本开放权重模型在研究代理系统中的潜力。

articles.title: Experience-Handoff Reinforcement Learning for Recursive Self-Improvement
articles.abstract: It is common to train Large Language Models (LLMs) for agentic tasks with Reinforcement Learning (RL) from scalar rewards. However, this throws away the fine-grained information about the environment that the agent experienced during the trial (e.g., error logs). To utilize this rich information, recent works wrap the agent in a harness that refines its own inputs through reflection or compaction and hands past experience to future rollouts, but the construction of the handed-off artifacts (e.g., a playbook) is itself not learned. We want the best of both worlds: gradient updates from a scalar reward, while also utilizing environment information to hand off experience. As a concrete testbed, we fix the Agentic Context Engineering (\ace{}) harness and train one model to act, reflect, and curate task-local playbooks. Our method, \acerl{}, evaluates candidate experience-handoff artifacts by their downstream effect on future actor rollouts, and co-optimizes the role-specific behaviors (action generator, insight reflector, and playbook curator) under a fixed scaffold. Across agentic benchmarks, \acerl{} achieves higher held-out performance than baseline methods. The results suggest that agent training should optimize not only the actions in the current rollout, but also the model-written experience that future rollouts inherit.
articles.titleCn: 递归自我改进的体验交接强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 通常使用强化学习（RL）从标量奖励中训练大型语言模型（LLM）用于代理任务。然而，这种方法会丢弃代理在试验过程中所体验的环境的细粒度信息（例如，错误日志）。为了利用这些丰富的信息，近期的研究将代理封装在一个框架中，通过反思或压缩来优化其自身的输入，并将过去的经验传递给未来的推进，但传递的工件（例如，剧本）的构建本身并不是通过学习实现的。我们希望兼顾两者的优点：从标量奖励中获得梯度更新，同时利用环境信息来传递经验。作为一个具体的测试平台，我们固定了代理上下文工程（\ace{})框架，并训练一个模型来执行、反思和编辑任务本地剧本。我们的方法，\acerl{}，通过候选经验传递工件对未来代理推进的影响来评估它们，并在固定的框架下协同优化特定角色的行为（动作生成器、洞察反思器和剧本编辑器）。在代理基准测试中，\acerl{}比基线方法实现了更高的保留性能。结果表明，代理训练不仅要优化当前推进中的动作，还要优化模型编写的、未来推进继承的经验。

articles.title: Saidzoda-Kazakh-EmbeddingGemma-300M: How Far One Epoch of Generated Questions Takes a Small Kazakh Embedder
articles.abstract: EmbeddingGemma-300M is a small open embedder, and used as released it finds the right passage first for 60.8% of the Kazakh Belebele retrieval questions. We present Saidzoda-Kazakh-EmbeddingGemma-300M, the same model fully fine-tuned for one epoch on 208,511 pairs: 166,263 Kazakh questions that our own language model wrote about source passages from encyclopedias, Wikipedia, news and books, each checked by a second model, plus English and Russian replay. On Kazakh Belebele, recall@1 rises from 60.8% to 78.0% and recall@10 from 76.3% to 91.4%. Our model scores above 161 of the 194 models with a published MTEB score on the same test, among them OpenAI text-embedding-3-large (47.1%). The other 33 score higher: the ten best are large multi-billion-parameter or closed models, reaching up to 92.2%, and at least 9 are open models of up to 0.6B parameters, the smallest with 339M. We also scored 6 Kazakh-specific embedders shared on Hugging Face with the same code in one run: our model (77.3% there) is ahead of 4 of them, including the two E5-base models of similar size (72.6% and 69.0%), and behind kaz-embedder (86.0%, three towers with 1,695M parameters in total) and a BGE-M3 fine-tune (81.0%); at recall@10 its interval overlaps those of its nearest neighbours on both sides. Our four-language model, trained with a capped share of the same Kazakh pairs, is 2.8 points lower at recall@1, with overlapping recall@10 intervals. The Kazakh model also scores higher than the released model on the Uzbek and Kyrgyz versions of Belebele, but our Tajik model, trained without any Turkic pairs, gains as much there, so these gains are not specific to Kazakh training. Our Kazakh Wikipedia test questions come from the same generator family as the training questions, so we rest the main claims on Belebele.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 8 tables, 2 figures. Technical report. Model: https://huggingface.co/Tohirju/Saidzoda-Kazakh-EmbeddingGemma-300M
articles.titleCn: 赛德佐达-哈萨克语-嵌入Gemma-300M：一个小的哈萨克语嵌入器生成一个问题需要多少个epoch
articles.abstractCn: EmbeddingGemma-300M是一款小型开源嵌入器，在默认使用情况下，对于哈萨克贝莱贝莱检索问题，其正确找到相关段落的比例为60.8%。我们提出了Saidzoda-Kazakh-EmbeddingGemma-300M，该模型在208,511对数据上进行了完整的一轮微调：其中166,263对是哈萨克问题，这些问题由我们自己的语言模型针对百科、维基百科、新闻和书籍中的源段落生成，每条问题都经过第二个模型的检查，并包含英语和俄语回译。在哈萨克贝莱贝莱上，recall@1从60.8%提升至78.0%，recall@10从76.3%提升至91.4%。我们的模型在相同测试中的MTEB分数超过194个已发布模型的161个，其中包括OpenAI的text-embedding-3-large（47.1%）。另外33个模型得分更高：前十个是大型多亿参数或封闭模型，最高达到92.2%，至少有9个是开放模型，参数量最高达0.6B，最小为339M。我们还使用相同代码对Hugging Face上共享的6个哈萨克特定嵌入器进行了评分：我们的模型（77.3%）超过了其中的4个，包括两个规模相似的E5-base模型（72.6%和69.0%），但落后于kaz-embedder（86.0%，包含三个1,695M参数的塔状模型）和BGE-M3微调（81.0%）；在recall@10上，其区间与两侧最近邻居的区间重叠。我们的四语言模型使用相同哈萨克对的限制份额进行训练，recall@1低2.8分，recall@10区间重叠。哈萨克模型在乌兹别克和吉尔吉斯贝莱贝莱版本上也得分高于发布模型，但我们的塔吉克模型在没有任何突厥语对的情况下在该测试中同样取得了显著提升，因此这些提升并非特定于哈萨克训练。我们的哈萨克维基百科测试问题与训练问题来自同一生成家族，因此我们将主要论点建立在贝莱贝莱上。

articles.title: Beyond Compressing Everything: Contrastive Memory Learning for Selective Context Compression
articles.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) advance toward increasingly long inputs, soft context compression offers a promising approach to efficient inference by converting long inputs into compact memory slots. Under limited memory budgets, effective context compression remains challenging because task-relevant evidence varies substantially across queries, ranging from localized evidence to multiple distant spans or information dispersed throughout the full document. Instead of compressing everything indiscriminately, we propose CoMem, a query-guided selective context compression framework that learns memory representations conditioned on both the document and the query. CoMem develops Contrastive Compressor Learning to achieve query-sensitive yet context-preserving memory representations. To inject a strong prior over query-dependent evidence distributions, we devise a same-context hard negative mining strategy by pairing a single document with multiple queries, requiring the compressor to selectively retain information according to each query's distinct evidence needs. To address the restricted information flow imposed by causal masking, we further enable bidirectional attention among memory slots. Experiments demonstrate that CoMem consistently outperforms existing context compression methods across compression ratios on question answering and RULER-NIAH benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/scar-on/CoMem.
articles.titleCn: 超越压缩一切：选择性上下文压缩的对比记忆学习
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）逐渐处理越来越长的输入，软上下文压缩通过将长输入转换为紧凑的内存槽位，为高效推理提供了一种有前景的方法。在有限的内存预算下，有效的上下文压缩仍然具有挑战性，因为任务相关的证据在不同查询之间差异很大，范围从局部证据到多个遥远的跨度或分散在整个文档中的信息。我们不是不加区分地压缩所有内容，而是提出了CoMem，这是一个基于查询的 selective 上下文压缩框架，它根据文档和查询学习内存表示。CoMem发展了对比压缩器学习，以实现查询敏感但上下文保留的内存表示。为了注入对查询相关证据分布的强先验知识，我们设计了一种相同上下文硬负采样策略，通过将单个文档与多个查询配对，要求压缩器根据每个查询独特的证据需求选择性地保留信息。为了解决因果掩码对信息流造成的限制，我们进一步在内存槽位之间启用了双向注意力。实验表明，CoMem在问答和RULER-NIAH基准测试的压缩率上始终优于现有的上下文压缩方法。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/scar-on/CoMem 获取。

articles.title: Recursive State-Augmented Language Models: Persistent Latent-State Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models
articles.abstract: Language models rely on finite token contexts, limiting access to earlier interactions. We introduce Recursive State-Augmented Language Models (Recursive SALM), a framework in which a persistent latent state evolves with each observation and generates adaptations of a pretrained language model. A modular read-transition-write architecture separates observation encoding, latent dynamics, and predictor adaptation. We develop deterministic and stochastic formulations. The experiments evaluate only deterministic SALM with frozen GPT-2 small and exclude earlier evidence from its decoder context. On a four-turn hypothesis-inference task, latent-gated LoRA reaches 89.1% accuracy, comparable to 88.0% for a trained full-context LoRA baseline, with earlier evidence available solely through a 64-dimensional state. Zeroing or shuffling the state substantially reduces accuracy. In a two-turn task with codewords unseen in training, several interfaces improve candidate ranking over chance, but rarely generate the exact codeword under the evaluated training schedule. These experiments show that persistent latent-conditioned adaptation can support sequential inference when earlier evidence is absent from the decoder context.
articles.titleCn: 递归状态增强语言模型：预训练语言模型的持续潜在状态适应
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型依赖于有限的标记上下文，限制了访问早期交互的能力。我们引入了递归状态增强语言模型（Recursive SALM），这是一个框架，其中持久的潜在状态随着每个观察结果而演变，并生成预训练语言模型的适应版本。一个模块化的读-转换-写架构将观察编码、潜在动态和预测器适应分离开来。我们开发了确定性和随机性公式。实验仅评估了具有冻结GPT-2小型的确定性SALM，并排除了其解码器上下文中的早期证据。在一个四轮假设-推理任务中，潜在门控LoRA达到89.1%的准确率，与训练完整上下文LoRA基线的88.0%相当，而早期证据仅通过一个64维状态可用。将状态置零或打乱会显著降低准确率。在一个训练中未见过的代码词的两轮任务中，几个接口在候选排名上优于随机猜测，但在评估的训练调度下很少生成确切的代码词。这些实验表明，当解码器上下文中缺少早期证据时，持久的潜在条件适应可以支持顺序推理。

articles.title: IsharaBART: An efficient BART-Based Framework for Low-Resource Bangla Sign Language Translation
articles.abstract: Millions of Bangla Sign Language (BdSL) users lack reliable automatic translation tools. Existing systems are limited by data scarcity, unidirectional design, and computationally expensive architectures that are not suitable for low-resource deployment. We introduce IsharaBART, a bidirectional generative framework for gloss-sentence translation in BdSL. IsharaBART uses Bidirectional and Auto-Regressive Transformers (BART)-based conditional language modeling with denoising learning objectives. We developed a parallel dataset of 1,000 professionally annotated gloss-sentence pairs, balanced across tenses and structures. We expanded the dataset to 4,831 pairs through four augmentation techniques: rule-based tense transformations, masked token substitutions, back-translation, and one-shot prompting. A compact denoising sequence-to-sequence model was pre-trained from scratch on monolingual Bangla text from six different corpora, then fine-tuned on the annotated and augmented datasets. We compare IsharaBART against four larger baseline models under identical conditions, where it achieves comparable or superior bidirectional performance. On the gloss-to-sentence (G2S) task, it attains Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU-4) score up to 51.7, and on the sentence-to-gloss (S2G) task, it achieves 61.40, outperforming multilingual models despite having fewer than 10% of the parameters. Ablation studies demonstrate that pre-training provides 62.5-90.4% faster convergence and 11.5-118% higher BLEU-4 than scratch. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces trainable parameters by 99.3%, but with 28.0-52.2% loss of BLEU-4 compared to full-parameter fine-tuning.
articles.titleCn: IsharaBART：一种基于BART的低资源孟加拉语手语翻译高效框架
articles.abstractCn: 数百万孟加拉手语（BdSL）使用者缺乏可靠的自动翻译工具。现有系统受限于数据匮乏、单向设计以及不适合低资源部署的高计算成本架构。我们介绍了IsharaBART，这是一个用于孟加拉手语术语-句子翻译的双向生成框架。IsharaBART采用基于双向和自回归Transformer（BART）的条件语言模型，结合去噪学习目标。我们开发了一个包含1000对专业标注的术语-句子对的平行数据集，涵盖了不同时态和结构。通过四种增强技术——基于规则的时态转换、掩码标记替换、回译和单次提示——我们将数据集扩展到4831对。我们使用六种不同语料库的孟加拉语单语文本从头开始预训练了一个紧凑的去噪序列到序列模型，然后在标注和增强数据集上进行微调。在相同条件下，我们将IsharaBART与四个更大的基线模型进行比较，其双向性能达到或优于基线模型。在术语到句子（G2S）任务中，它达到了51.7的Bilingual Evaluation Understudy（BLEU-4）分数，在句子到术语（S2G）任务中，它达到了61.40，尽管参数数量不到10%，但仍优于多语言模型。消融研究表明，预训练比从头开始训练的收敛速度提高了62.5-90.4%，BLEU-4分数提高了11.5-118%。低秩适配（LoRA）将可训练参数减少了99.3%，但与全参数微调相比，BLEU-4分数损失了28.0-52.2%。

articles.title: Does Deep Knowledge Tracing Learn Semantic Relations Between Knowledge Components?
articles.abstract: Deep Knowledge Tracing (DKT) is a knowledge tracing (KT) model that updates a shared latent state from sequences of interactions, each pairing a knowledge component (KC) with a response. An interaction with one KC can therefore affect predictions for other KCs. We ask: Are the KC relations learned by DKT semantic? We construct text-derived semantic KC representations using nine pipelines to test whether the conclusions hold across alternative ways of constructing those representations. The first test compares DKT-derived KC relation graphs with semantic relation structures induced by pairwise cosine similarities among the KC representations. Across the evaluated datasets, embedding models, and pipelines, the two structures align only weakly and inconsistently. The second test introduces semantic information into DKT; the pretrained text-derived representations do not consistently outperform the standard DKT baseline. In the reduced-data experiments, semantic initialization yields a higher test area under the ROC curve (AUC) than the baseline at eight of nine nested sample sizes for ASSISTments 2017. KC-supervised fine-tuned BERT produces small positive AUC differences in some matched comparisons, but the study does not establish their stability across runs. These effects remain limited and inconsistent. The findings suggest that behavioral, temporal, structural, or psychometric signals may also shape DKT's learned relations. DKT-derived relations are not primarily semantic: the tested text-derived semantic structures do not strongly recover the DKT-derived relation structure.
articles.titleCn: 深度知识追踪学习知识组件之间的语义关系吗？
articles.abstractCn: 深度知识追踪（DKT）是一种知识追踪（KT）模型，它通过一系列交互更新共享的潜在状态，每个交互将一个知识成分（KC）与一个响应配对。因此，与一个KC的交互可以影响对其他KC的预测。我们提出的问题：DKT学习到的KC关系是否具有语义性？我们使用九种流程构建基于文本的语义KC表示，以测试这些结论是否在不同的表示构建方式下仍然成立。第一个测试比较了DKT衍生的KC关系图与通过KC表示之间的成对余弦相似性诱导的语义关系结构。在评估的数据集、嵌入模型和流程中，这两种结构仅微弱且不一致地吻合。第二个测试将语义信息引入DKT；预训练的文本衍生表示并未始终优于标准DKT基线。在减少数据的实验中，对于ASSISTments 2017，语义初始化在九个嵌套样本大小中的八个上产生了比基线更高的ROC曲线下面积（AUC）。KC监督微调的BERT在一些匹配比较中产生了微小的正向AUC差异，但该研究并未证明它们在不同运行中的稳定性。这些效应仍然有限且不一致。研究结果表明，行为、时间、结构或心理测量信号也可能塑造DKT学习到的关系。DKT衍生的关系并非主要是语义的：测试的基于文本的语义结构并未强烈恢复DKT衍生的关系结构。

articles.title: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation
articles.abstract: Transferring LLMs into System One decision models typically replaces the language modeling head with a decision head while retaining the full backbone, making every decision pay for all layers. Yet it remains unclear how much depth such decisions require. We find that decision information is concentrated in intermediate layers, with early layers building essential features and the final six layers removable without loss, while independently trained smaller models largely mimic the full model rather than developing specialized decision capabilities. These findings suggest that efficiency requires not simply smaller backbones, but shared computation across different depths. Building on this, we propose \method{}, which jointly trains a full model with prefix sub-models that share its final layers and decision head through self-distillation. A lightweight gate reads the hidden state at each exit to determine whether additional computation is needed, allowing one model to operate at multiple layers. Across seven decision benchmarks, our approach matches or outperforms independently trained models at every depth, while achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs through adaptive computation.
articles.titleCn: 从大型语言模型到自适应计算的高效系统一模型
articles.abstractCn: 将大型语言模型（LLMs）转化为系统一决策模型通常用决策头替换语言建模头，同时保留完整的主干结构，使得每个决策都为所有层付费。然而，这种决策需要多少深度仍不明确。我们发现决策信息集中在中间层，早期层构建了基本特征，而最后六层可以移除而不损失性能，而独立训练的小模型主要模仿完整模型，而不是发展专门的决策能力。这些发现表明，效率不仅需要更小的主干结构，还需要跨不同深度的共享计算。基于此，我们提出了\method{}方法，该方法通过自蒸馏共享最终层和决策头，联合训练完整模型和前缀子模型。一个轻量级门控读取每个出口的隐藏状态，以确定是否需要额外计算，使一个模型能在多个层上运行。在七个决策基准测试中，我们的方法在每个深度上都与独立训练的模型相当或优于它们，同时通过自适应计算实现了更好的精度-效率权衡。

articles.title: Eliciting and Mitigating Specification Satisficing in Coding Agents
articles.abstract: Coding agents often fail to meet all requirements in the task description. In some of these failures, the agent considers an implementation choice that meets a requirement, but later decides to commit to another one that does not meet the requirement for a reason it finds acceptable. We call this specification satisficing. It is challenging to identify and mitigate specification satisficing because the agent accepts such choices for its own reasons, and existing self-correction methods are biased toward them. We propose SatisFix, which guides a coding agent to report these choices and their reasons, and then check each choice against the task description. We evaluate SatisFix on DeepSWE and SWE-bench Pro with five LLMs as backbones and two different agent frameworks, and compare it with three self-correction methods. SatisFix improves the pass@1 of the base agent by an average of 5.09% on DeepSWE and 7.06% on the hard subset of SWE-bench Pro. On DeepSWE, it outperforms the best baseline by 3.98%. Our ablation study shows that both steps of SatisFix contribute to the improvement.
articles.titleCn: 激发与缓解编码代理的规范满足
articles.abstractCn: 编码代理常常无法满足任务描述中的所有要求。在某些情况下，代理会考虑一个满足要求的实现选择，但随后又因为认为可以接受的理由而决定提交另一个不满足要求的选择。我们将这种现象称为规范满足。识别和缓解规范满足具有挑战性，因为代理会为其自身理由接受这些选择，而现有的自我纠正方法倾向于偏向这些选择。我们提出了SatisFix，它引导编码代理报告这些选择及其原因，然后对照任务描述检查每个选择。我们在DeepSWE和SWE-bench Pro上使用五个LLM作为主干和两种不同的代理框架评估了SatisFix，并将其与三种自我纠正方法进行了比较。SatisFix使基础代理在DeepSWE上的pass@1平均提高了5.09%，在SWE-bench Pro的困难子集上提高了7.06%。在DeepSWE上，它比最佳基线提高了3.98%。我们的消融研究表明，SatisFix的两个步骤都对改进做出了贡献。

articles.title: SMIC: Shared Multiscale Input-Reference Conditioning across Transformer Layers for Natural Language Inference
articles.abstract: Natural Language Inference models can be sensitive to localized lexical changes. We introduce Shared Multiscale Input-Reference Conditioning (SMIC), which constructs a single input-dependent multiscale reference and reuses it across Transformer layers. Each layer applies its own multiscale transformation to the shared reference and injects the resulting conditioning feature before the attention update. We instantiate SMIC in a token--context Transformer (TCT) and conduct from-scratch comparisons against decoder-based and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) baselines across all three ANLI rounds. TCT-SMIC attains the highest observed ten-seed mean accuracy on all three ANLI rounds. The ablations further support the contribution of SMIC. We evaluate a real-valued Llama-style plug-in and extend deletion/insertion diagnostics to pretrained ModernBERT encoder and Llama decoder models with and without SMIC. Across the evaluated perturbation protocols, TCT-SMIC exhibits comparatively low pooled-attention redistribution and smaller signed accuracy changes. We further establish a finite-sample bound on average subset-mass redistribution in terms of the mean Jensen--Shannon divergence between the restricted and renormalized attention distributions.
articles.titleCn: SMIC：跨Transformer层共享多尺度输入-参考调节用于自然语言推理
articles.abstractCn: 自然语言推理模型对局部的词汇变化可能很敏感。我们引入了共享多尺度输入-参考条件化（SMIC），该技术构建一个单一的、依赖于输入的多尺度参考，并在Transformer层之间重复使用它。每一层将其自己的多尺度变换应用于共享参考，并在注意力更新之前注入由此产生的条件特征。我们在基于token-上下文的Transformer（TCT）中实例化了SMIC，并与基于解码器和多层感知器（MLP）的基线进行了从头开始的比较，涵盖了所有三个ANLI轮次。TCT-SMIC在所有三个ANLI轮次中达到了观察到的最高十种子平均准确率。消融实验进一步支持了SMIC的贡献。我们评估了一个实值Llama风格的插件，并将删除/插入诊断扩展到了预训练的ModernBERT编码器和Llama解码器模型（包括和不包括SMIC）。在所有评估的扰动协议中，TCT-SMIC表现出相对较低的池化注意力重新分配，并且符号准确率变化较小。我们进一步在平均子集质量重新分配方面建立了关于受限和重新归一化注意力分布之间平均Jensen-Shannon散度的有限样本界限。

articles.title: Label-Efficient Document-Grounded Factuality Detection via Cross-Paraphrastic Invariance Learning
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent claims that are unsupported by a given source document, motivating accurate and efficient document-grounded factuality detection. Existing LLM-based evaluators often require repeated inference and incur high computational cost, whereas compact factuality detectors are efficient at inference time but commonly rely on large labeled or synthetically generated corpora. We propose CPIL (Cross-Paraphrastic Invariance Learning), a two-stage Siamese framework that converts a small labeled set into relational supervision without acquiring additional factuality labels. CPIL constructs positive pairs from distinct label-preserving paraphrastic views of the same document-claim instance and negative pairs from opposite-label examples associated with the same source document. It further introduces quantile-aware semi-hard negative mining, which derives a boundary from the positive-pair similarity distribution and balances informative negatives with broader coverage. In the two-stage training procedure, Stage 1 learns an encoder from these task-aware pairs, and Stage 2 jointly fine-tunes the encoder and a linear classification head for binary factuality prediction. At inference time, CPIL requires no paraphrase generation, pair construction, or Siamese comparison and uses only one encoder-classifier forward pass. On the 11-task LLM-AggreFact benchmark, CPIL-2% and CPIL-3% achieve macro-F1 scores of 81.04 and 81.60 while using only 2-3% of the FactCG-released labeled pool. Both settings outperform all compared compact detectors and two vanilla LLM references. Ablations and sensitivity analyses support the contributions of task-aware pair construction, dynamic negative mining, and multi-pivot paraphrasing.
articles.titleCn: 基于跨释义不变性学习的标签高效文档固有事实检测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够生成与给定源文档不符的流畅声明，从而促使进行准确高效的基于文档的事实性检测。现有的基于LLM的评估器通常需要重复推理并产生高昂的计算成本，而紧凑型事实性检测器在推理时高效，但通常依赖于大规模标注或合成生成的语料库。我们提出了CPIL（跨释义不变性学习），这是一种两阶段的Siamese框架，它将一个小型标注集转换为关系型监督，而无需获取额外的事实性标签。CPIL从同一文档声明实例的不同标签保留释义视图中构建正例对，从与同一源文档相关联的相反标签示例中构建负例对。它进一步引入了分位数感知半硬负例挖掘，该挖掘从正例对相似度分布中导出边界，并平衡信息量大的负例与更广泛的覆盖范围。在两阶段训练过程中，第一阶段从这些任务感知对中学习编码器，第二阶段联合微调编码器和线性分类头进行二分类事实性预测。在推理时，CPIL无需生成释义、构建对或进行Siamese比较，仅需一次编码器-分类器前向传递。在11任务LLM-AggreFact基准测试中，CPIL-2%和CPIL-3%分别达到81.04和81.60的宏F1分数，而仅使用了FactCG发布的2-3%标注池。这两种设置均优于所有比较的紧凑型检测器和两个基础LLM参考模型。消融实验和敏感性分析支持任务感知对构建、动态负例挖掘和多枢轴释义的贡献。

articles.title: Low Language Transfer Speech-to-Text
articles.abstract: A multilingual speech recogniser has heard much speech in its own languages. We ask how much of that it brings to a language it was never trained on, when it is fine-tuned on the little that language has. We score 28 open multilingual models untouched on Low-Language-TTS, 50 low-resource languages in 11 writing systems, and fine-tune 24 of them on at most 1,000 clips a language, 82 hours in all, with a dev set choosing every epoch. Fine-tuning lowers every model's macro character error rate (CER), by 16.6 to 53.1 points, to 9.5 at best, and a word language model takes three CTC models 1.2 to 1.4 points lower; WER is still 34.4 at best. On the 12 languages that no model lists, every model starts at 46 or worse and the best ends at 11.7. The same architectures from random weights stay 60 points or more behind, so the gain is transfer, and an encoder left untouched already gives a Whisper or Qwen decoder most of what it needs. It is the language, not the corpus: on FLEURS recordings that ours do not share, the median model keeps 79% of its gain. It costs the languages the models knew, 5.7 points of CER on English, Spanish, French and German in the median model. Low-rank adapters on 4% of the weights come within 1.1 points of tuning everything, and on 2 of 3 models forget less. Seq2seq and language-model decoders are done within three to five epochs, while a new CTC head is still improving at twenty or thirty. Data beats epochs: 25 clips a language take Qwen3-ASR 0.6B from 60.9 to 39.3, and at equal clips presented, ten times the data is worth 9.7 points. A model that first learned forty of the languages learns the other ten no faster. On a public Malay benchmark, untouched Whisper large-v3 scores 8.9 when it detects the language and 14.9 when told the clip is Malay, because it then translates the English that speakers mix in; trained on the Scicom telephony dataset it scores 6.0.
articles.titleCn: 低语言迁移语音转文本
articles.abstractCn: 一个多语言语音识别器在其母语中已听过大量语音。我们探究它在仅用该语言少量数据微调后，能将其母语知识迁移多少到从未训练过的语言中。我们对28个未经微调的开放多语言模型、11种书写系统的50种低资源语言进行评分，并从中选择24种语言，每种语言最多用1000个片段（共82小时），使用开发集选择每个训练周期进行微调。微调使所有模型的宏观字符错误率（CER）降低了16.6至53.1点，最佳降至9.5，而单词语言模型比3个CTC模型低1.2至1.4点；最佳词错误率（WER）仍为34.4。在12种模型未列出的语言中，所有模型的初始错误率均为46或更高，而最佳模型最终降至11.7。使用相同架构从随机权重开始的模型仍落后60点以上，因此这种提升是迁移学习，未微调的编码器已为Whisper或Qwen解码器提供了大部分所需知识。关键在于语言本身而非语料库：在我们未共享的FLEURS录音中，中位模型仍保留79%的增益。模型所熟悉的语言代价为：中位模型在英语、西班牙语、法语和德语上的CER损失了5.7点。低秩适配器在4%的权重上接近全面微调，且在3/4模型中遗忘更少。Seq2seq和语言模型解码器在三至五个训练周期内完成，而新的CTC头部在二十或三十个周期后仍在改进。数据胜过周期数：每种语言25个片段将Qwen3-ASR 0.6B的WER从60.9降至39.3，且在相同片段数下，十倍数据的价值相当于9.7点。首先学习四十种语言的模型，学习另外十种语言的速度并未更快。在公共马来语基准测试中，未经微调的Whisper large-v3在检测到语言时得分为8.9，在被告知片段为马来语时得分为14.9，因为它会将说话者混合的英语翻译出来；而在Scicom电话数据集上微调后，得分降至6.0。

articles.title: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: We run reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO across four environments, starting from a supervised fine-tuned 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model covering English and eight Indic languages. We compare the model before and after RL across 34 benchmarks in one evaluation campaign. MATH improves by 36.07 points, and most Indic benchmarks also improve. Yet XQuAD-Indic F1 falls 19.32 points as English answers rise from 8.7% to 91.7%; IndicQA falls 8.64, while English XQuAD gains 11.71 F1. A second RL run from the same supervised initialization adds an Indic environment together with language and repetition rewards. Compared with the released model, it improves both passage-answering and instruction-following benchmarks, along with preserving MATH performance. But it loses ground on reasoning and coding benchmarks. Several training choices changed together, so we cannot isolate the effect of any one of the reward terms. Script compliance remains unresolved. Adding a language reward did not ensure use of the requested script. Passage answering and script compliance therefore need direct evaluation, even when other benchmark scores improve.
articles.comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
articles.titleCn: 强化学习后的印地语任务增益与退化
articles.abstractCn: 我们在四个环境中运行了带有GRPO的强化学习（RL），起始模型为涵盖英语和八种印度语、经过监督微调的30B-A3B专家混合模型。在一个评估活动中，我们在34个基准测试中比较了RL前后模型的性能。MATH得分提高了36.07分，大多数印度语基准测试也取得了提升。然而，随着英语答案比例从8.7%上升到91.7%，XQuAD-Indic F1得分下降了19.32分；IndicQA得分下降了8.64分，而英语XQuAD F1得分则提高了11.71分。第二次从相同的监督初始化进行RL运行，同时增加了印度语环境以及语言和重复奖励。与发布的模型相比，它在段落回答和指令遵循基准测试中均有提升，并保持了MATH性能。但它却在推理和编码基准测试中表现下降。由于同时更改了多个训练选择，我们无法分离出任何一个奖励项的影响。脚本合规性问题仍未解决。增加语言奖励并不能确保使用请求的脚本。因此，即使其他基准测试得分提高，段落回答和脚本合规性仍需直接评估。

articles.title: We Are What We Remember: Mental-State-Driven Memory for Long-Term Character Dialogue
articles.abstract: Shared history in human dialogue is not merely a repository of facts, but the foundation of evolving relationships and mutual understanding. However, mainstream conversational memory systems rely on passive semantic similarity over external fact stores, frequently retrieving topically similar records while missing relationally pivotal experiences. Inspired by cognitive psychology's Self-Memory System (SMS), we propose MindMem, a mental-state-driven memory framework that asynchronously consolidates shared experiences into source-linked mental states of the character, the user, and their relationship. At each turn, a specialized mental-state reasoner (Mind) contextualizes these persistent states to anticipate latent user needs, form proactive intentions, and recover supporting episodic evidence that surface-level matching overlooks. To evaluate history-sensitive adaptation beyond factual recall, we introduce MemReal-Bench, a longitudinal benchmark grounded in month-long real-user interactions across dyadic and group scenes. By pairing Direct Question Answering (DQA) with Situated Memory Realization (SMR), it tests whether agents bridge the gap between knowing past facts and naturally using shared history, world rules, and relational trajectories. On MemReal-Bench, MindMem reaches 59.03% SMR and 82.58% DQA, exceeding the strongest memory baseline by 24.19 and 9.19 percentage points, respectively, and outperforming oracle target-memory injection on SMR. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/jiazhicheng7-ctrl/MindMem.
articles.comment: Zhicheng Jia, Shuchen Wu, and Zhuoshi Tong contributed equally to this work
articles.titleCn: 我们是谁，取决于我们记得什么：基于心智状态的长期角色对话记忆
articles.abstractCn: 人类对话中的共享历史不仅是一个事实的存储库，更是发展关系和相互理解的基础。然而，主流对话记忆系统依赖于对外部事实库的被动语义相似性，经常检索主题相似的记录，却忽略了关系上关键的经历。受认知心理学中自我记忆系统（SMS）的启发，我们提出了MindMem，一个由心理状态驱动的记忆框架，该框架异步地将共享经历整合到角色、用户及其关系的源链接心理状态中。在每一轮对话中，一个专门的心理状态推理器（Mind）将这些持久状态进行情境化，以预测潜在的用户需求，形成主动意图，并恢复表层匹配所忽略的支持性情景证据。为了评估超越事实回忆的历史敏感适应性，我们引入了MemReal-Bench，这是一个基于长达一个月的真实用户交互的纵向基准，涵盖了二元和群体场景。通过将直接问答（DQA）与情境记忆实现（SMR）相结合，它测试了智能体是否能够弥合了解过去事实与自然使用共享历史、世界规则和关系轨迹之间的差距。在MemReal-Bench上，MindMem达到了59.03%的SMR和82.58%的DQA，分别超过了最强的记忆基线高24.19和9.19个百分点，并且在SMR上优于神谕目标记忆注入。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/jiazhicheng7-ctrl/MindMem获取。

articles.title: Data-Efficient LLM Safety Alignment Guided by Interpretable Features
articles.abstract: Existing large language models typically rely on massive fine-tuning datasets for safety alignment, which results in higher costs for safety alignment and often leads to the problem of over-refusal. We propose Less is Safer (LIS), a compact yet highly effective dataset for safety alignment, constructed through interpretable feature-guided selection and adversarial synthesis. Specifically, we leverage Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) activations to efficiently select prompts that cover diverse and interpretable safety features. Then, we employ a multi-agent adversarial synthesis framework to generate harmless prompts that nevertheless elicit unnecessary refusals. LIS contains only 2.4K samples, yet outperforms much larger datasets, e.g., TRIDENT-Core (26K), TRIDENT-Edge (19K) and WildJailbreak (262K), in overall performance on four safety and five over-refusal benchmarks. Through ablation experiments, we demonstrate that neither safety data nor over-refusal data alone can achieve optimal results. We also used safety features from SAE, annotated by an LLM, for data filtering, but the results were inferior to those obtained using the pipeline proposed in this paper.
articles.titleCn: 以可解释特征为指导的高效数据LLM安全对齐
articles.abstractCn: 现有的大型语言模型通常依赖于大规模的微调数据集进行安全对齐，这导致安全对齐的成本更高，并且常常导致过度拒绝的问题。我们提出了Less is Safer (LIS)，一个紧凑但高效的安全对齐数据集，通过可解释的特征引导选择和对抗合成构建。具体来说，我们利用稀疏自动编码器（SAE）的激活来高效选择涵盖多样化和可解释安全特征的提示。然后，我们采用多智能体对抗合成框架来生成无害的提示，但这些提示仍然会引发不必要的拒绝。LIS仅包含2.4K样本，但在四个安全性和五个过度拒绝基准测试中的整体性能优于更大的数据集，例如TRIDENT-Core（26K）、TRIDENT-Edge（19K）和WildJailbreak（262K）。通过消融实验，我们证明了单独的安全数据或过度拒绝数据都不能达到最佳结果。我们还使用了由大型语言模型标注的SAE安全特征进行数据过滤，但结果不如本文提出的流程获得的结果。

articles.title: JudgeMix: Judge-Guided Mixed-Rollout Data Synthesis for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert trajectories is a standard paradigm for training LLM agents. However, it suffers from a well-known training-inference distribution mismatch, calling for target-aware data synthesis strategies that ground the training data in the target model's native state distribution. To bridge this gap, emerging approaches incorporate the expert either to guide mixed rollouts alongside the target model, or to provide dense step-wise supervision. Nonetheless, existing methods apply expert assistance blind to the target model's inherent behavior: they either disrupt the rollout using sub-optimal random intervention heuristics, or they enforce indiscriminate uniform supervision that unnecessarily overwrites the model's already-correct actions. We introduce JudgeMix, a judge-guided data synthesis framework that dynamically interleaves the target model and expert based on step-wise semantic evaluations. JudgeMix queries expert guidance precisely when the target model struggles, ensuring high trajectory success rates while keeping the state distribution aligned with the target model. It additionally uses the judge evaluation to reweight expert supervision on different steps, preserving model's inherent valid behavior while correcting its errors. On two agentic tool-use benchmarks, AppWorld and AutomationBench, JudgeMix demonstrates consistent superior performance to existing methods, with improvements up to 10 pass@1 points.
articles.titleCn: JudgeMix：用于LLM代理的裁判引导混合输出数据合成
articles.abstractCn: 在专家轨迹上的监督微调（SFT）是训练大型语言模型（LLM）代理的标准范式。然而，它存在一个众所周知的训练-推理分布不匹配问题，需要采用以目标模型为基准的数据合成策略，将训练数据建立在目标模型的自然状态分布上。为了弥补这一差距，新兴方法将专家引入其中，以指导与目标模型混合的推进过程，或提供密集的逐步监督。然而，现有方法对目标模型的内在行为缺乏感知：它们要么使用次优随机干预启发式方法中断推进过程，要么强制执行无差别的均匀监督，不必要地覆盖模型已经正确的动作。我们引入了JudgeMix，这是一个基于裁判指导的数据合成框架，根据逐步语义评估动态地交替目标模型和专家。JudgeMix在目标模型遇到困难时精确地查询专家指导，确保高轨迹成功率，同时保持状态分布与目标模型一致。它还使用裁判评估对不同步骤的专家监督进行重新加权，在纠正模型错误的同时保留其固有的有效行为。在两个代理工具使用基准测试AppWorld和AutomationBench上，JudgeMix始终优于现有方法，性能提升高达10个pass@1点。

articles.title: Temporal Context-Aware Spam Detection Using Transformer-Based NLP Models
articles.abstract: Spam detection is usually treated as single-message classification, ignoring behavioral patterns that emerge across sequences of messages from the same sender. We study outbound SMS spam detection at the carrier level, where the goal is to predict at send time whether a carrier will flag a message as spam. Using a proprietary production database of 43,741 outbound SMS messages with UTC transmission timestamps and carrier delivery statuses, we report three sets of results. On an 8,749-message held-out test set, a TF-IDF + logistic regression baseline reaches AUC-ROC 0.8721, and a text-only DeBERTa-v3-base classifier reaches AUC-ROC 0.9011 and F1 0.8412. A deployed DistilBERT model augmented with inter-message temporal features reaches accuracy 0.8238, spam-class F1 0.8382, and recall 0.9128 at threshold 0.5 on a separate, class-balanced 20,000-message production evaluation set; these results are not directly comparable with the held-out test results. We also describe TemporalBertSpam, an architecture that encodes each sender's message history with a causal Transformer, and outline the same-split evaluation needed to measure its contribution.
articles.titleCn: 基于Transformer的NLP模型的时间上下文感知垃圾邮件检测
articles.abstractCn: 垃圾邮件检测通常被视为单消息分类问题，忽略了来自同一发件人消息序列中出现的行文模式。我们研究运营商层面的呼出短信垃圾邮件检测，目标是预测在发送时运营商是否会将消息标记为垃圾邮件。利用一个包含43,741条呼出短信消息、具有UTC传输时间戳和运营商投递状态的专有生产数据库，我们报告了三组结果。在一个包含8,749条消息的保留测试集上，TF-IDF+逻辑回归基线模型达到了AUC-ROC 0.8721，而仅使用文本的DeBERTa-v3-base分类器达到了AUC-ROC 0.9011和F1 0.8412。一个部署的DistilBERT模型，通过添加消息间时间特征，在另一个独立的、类别平衡的20,000条消息生产评估集上，在阈值0.5时达到了准确率0.8238、垃圾邮件类F1 0.8382和召回率0.9128；这些结果与保留测试结果不能直接比较。我们还描述了TemporalBertSpam，这是一种使用因果Transformer对每个发件人的消息历史进行编码的架构，并概述了测量其贡献所需的相同分割评估。
